translatedData.content:
zk.money restarts to offer Aztec private transfers, but the V5 vulnerability risk must be checked first

Aztec Labs reopened zk.money self-custody wallets on September 29, 2026. Users can deposit DAI, USDC, or USDT from Ethereum, and then transfer in DAI within the Aztec network; when depositing USDC and USDT, they are converted into DAI. Internal transfers within Aztec can conceal the amount, balance, and payer/recipient, but when funds are deposited from Ethereum, the sending address and amount on the main network remain public. CoinDesk reports that the alpha version will limit each deposit, payment, and withdrawal to below $2,500, and set a daily total deposit cap; these limits are risk controls in the experimental phase, not guarantees of funds.

More importantly is the network security status. Aztec’s official documentation describes the current alpha as software still in early operation and not fully audited, meaning critical flaws could still emerge. On August 7, 2026, Aztec disclosed that contributors found a serious vulnerability in the V5 alpha proving system on July 27: an attacker could construct state transitions that do not follow protocol rules. The team could not determine whether the vulnerability had been exploited before it was discovered; the remediation plan is to address it in the subsequent V6. At the time, the official guidance required treating the funds, application, and contract state on V5 as potentially subject to protocol-level failures until emergency remediation is completed and the operations required by the network operators are carried out.

CoinDesk reported on September 29 that zk.money would go live before the vulnerability fix; Aztec Labs CEO said there were payment issues caused by another Oxide check bug, but the report did not say whether it could protect against the V5 proving system vulnerability. Self-custody means the app operators cannot directly spend or freeze users’ wallet assets, but it cannot eliminate the risk of losses caused by defects in the underlying network or contracts.

【My analysis and response】
This relaunch makes it easier for users to try private payments in the Ethereum ecosystem, but privacy only covers part of the activity after assets enter Aztec—deposit addresses and amounts still leave a trace on L1. The new wallet’s limits also cannot replace an audit. Since the V5 issue disclosed by Aztec relates to network state validation, until there is a specific fixed version and independent audits, I will not equate availability with suitability for storing funds intended for real use. If it is only for technical testing, you should first confirm the current network version, the official emergency status, and the scope of applicability, and use only small isolated addresses whose full loss you can afford; do not mistake public deposit records for already being anonymized.

Spillover to the crypto market could come from growth in private payment usage and changes in L2 activity, but there is currently no data indicating新增 active users, trading volume, or fee revenue. The product-related $ETH  is for Ethereum mainnet deposits and transaction fees. Binance spot ETHUSDT was queried at 00:24 (Beijing time) on September 30; the trailing 24-hour quoteVolume is about 888.87 million USD. This is data for a single spot trading pair; it cannot show that zk.money’s launch creates ETH demand, nor does it represent total market trading volume.

Going forward, we should first see whether the V6 fix is actually deployed, whether Aztec has confirmed completion of emergency remediation, whether independent audits and the migration plan are publicly available, and whether zk.money has disclosed its current running version and Oxide’s specific protection boundaries; then we should monitor privacy transaction volume, limit adjustments, and user retention. If the product is proven to run in a version isolated from the V5 vulnerability and has been audited, the security assessment can be re-evaluated; if it still relies on unpatched V5 or lacks verifiable mitigation measures, then privacy convenience should not be a reason to keep depositing funds.

Source:
CoinDesk, September 29, 2026: “Ethereum users get another way to pay privately as zk.money returns after three years”: https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2026/09/29/embargo-12-et-ethereum-users-get-another-way-to-pay-privately-as-zk-money-returns-after-three-years

zk.money 重启提供 Aztec 私密转账，但 V5 漏洞风险必须先看

Aztec Labs 于2026年9月29日重新开放 zk.money 自托管钱包，用户可从 Ethereum 存入 DAI、USDC 或 USDT，在 Aztec 网络内以 DAI 转账；USDC 与 USDT 入金时会转换成 DAI。Aztec 内部转账可隐藏金额、余额和收付款方，但从 Ethereum 存入时，主网上的发送地址与金额仍然公开。CoinDesk 报道称，Alpha 版本将每笔存款、支付和提款限制在2,500美元以下，并设每日总存款额度；这类上限是实验阶段的风险控制，不是资金保障。

更关键的是网络安全状态。Aztec 官方文档将当前 Alpha 描述为仍在早期运行、未经完整审计的软件，关键缺陷仍可能出现。Aztec 于2026年8月7日披露，贡献者在7月27日发现 V5 Alpha 证明系统存在严重漏洞：攻击者可能构造出不符合协议规则的状态转换；团队无法判断该漏洞在发现前是否曾被利用，修复计划是后续 V6。官方当时要求将 V5 上的资金、应用和合约状态视为可能遭遇协议级故障，直到完成应急处置与网络运营者所需操作。

CoinDesk 9月29日报道称，zk.money 会在该漏洞修复前上线；Aztec Labs CEO 说另有 Oxide 检查软件错误导致的支付问题，但报道没有说明它是否能防护 V5 证明系统漏洞。自托管意味着应用运营方不能直接替用户花费或冻结钱包资产，却不能消除底层网络或合约缺陷造成的损失风险。

【我的分析与应对】
这次上线让用户更容易在 Ethereum 生态尝试私密支付，但隐私只覆盖资产进入 Aztec 后的部分活动，入金地址和金额仍在 L1 留痕；新钱包的限额也不能替代审计。由于 Aztec 官方披露的 V5 问题涉及网络状态验证，在有明确修复版本和独立审计前，我不会把可用性等同于适合存放有实际用途的资金。若仅做技术测试，也应先确认当前网络版本、官方应急状态及适用范围，并只用可承受全部损失的小额隔离地址；不要把公开的入金记录误认为已经匿名。

对加密市场的传导可能来自隐私支付使用增长和 L2 活动变化，但目前没有新增活跃用户、交易量或费用收入数据。与产品相关的 $ETH 用于 Ethereum 主网入金和交易费用；币安现货 ETHUSDT 于北京时间9月30日00:24查询，滚动24小时成交额（quoteVolume）约8.887亿美元。这是单一现货交易对数据，不能说明 zk.money 上线带来 ETH 需求，也不代表全市场成交额。

后续应先看 V6 修复是否实际部署、Aztec 是否确认完成应急处置、独立审计与迁移方案是否公开，以及 zk.money 是否披露其当前运行版本和 Oxide 的具体防护边界；再观察隐私交易量、限额调整和用户留存。若产品被证实运行在不受 V5 漏洞影响且经过审计的隔离版本，可重新评估安全判断；若仍依赖未修复的 V5 或没有可验证的补救措施，就不应把隐私便利当作继续存入资金的理由。

Aztec Labs has finally sorted out the privacy wallet zk.money that they shut down back in 2023, and has brought it back on their own Layer 2 network. This is good news for crypto users who want to make money but fear showing too much, but it could be a nightmare for other privacy projects in the Ethereum ecosystem.

Why is this news important?
In plain terms, Aztec’s revamp of this wallet is meant to fix the original version’s terrible user experience. In 2023, they messed up the first iteration, but now they’ve relaunched it—like a game studio releasing a bug-fix patch. The target users are those who need privacy protection and also want cheaper transactions on L2. For the broader Ethereum Layer 2 privacy ecosystem, it’s a signal: if user demand exists, the technology—no matter how imperfect—has to find a way to meet it.

Market impact
This news may not have a direct impact on BTC and ETH, since it’s essentially just a wallet relaunch. However, it suggests that there’s still demand for privacy on Ethereum Layer 2. If zk.money performs well, it may attract some users away from projects like Polygon zkEVM and Starknet, making competition among L2s even fiercer. For regulators, the existence of more such projects indicates that privacy needs are real, and oversight may become more cautious.

Trading approach

💡 If Aztec can successfully win over users and hold the $2,670 level, ETH should be relatively stable in the short term. But if L2 privacy competition gets too intense and causes capital to flow out of the entire L2 sector, then the view would be invalidated if it breaks below $2,640.

Glamsterdam goes first on Sepolia; it doesn’t mean the mainnet price will be changed immediately.

The Ethereum Foundation announced that this network upgrade will be activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6 at 21:53:36, corresponding to epoch 353024 and slot 11296768. The activation dates for Hoodi and the mainnet have not yet been determined.

This upgrade combines the execution layer Amsterdam and the consensus layer Gloas. Key changes include embedded PBS and block-level access lists. The goal is to improve L1 throughput and make gas fee accounting more closely aligned with the costs of execution and state growth. Node operators must update their execution-layer and consensus-layer clients before activation. Contracts that rely on fixed gas assumptions may need to be modified.

If Sepolia runs smoothly, the market is more likely to interpret it as a continuation of the Ethereum L1 scaling narrative. If subsequent client updates and compatibility checks slow things down, attention will shift back to the Hoodi and mainnet timelines. Are you more focused on the testnet rollout, or the mainnet schedule?

As of September 29, 2026, Ethereum’s spot price is $2,710.96. Over the past 24 hours, it has shown a volatile decline. From hourly candlestick charts, after topping near $2,738, the price has been retreating continuously. The low has touched $2,672, and it is currently consolidating above $2,710.

In terms of price structure, Ethereum has formed short-term pressure in the $2,730 to $2,750 range, while the $2,670 to $2,700 range serves as an important support zone. Similar to Bitcoin, Ethereum’s pullback magnitude is relatively moderate, and the overall market remains in a high-level range-bound pattern.

Trading volume data show the latest hourly volume is $49.28 million, larger than in the prior period. An increase in volume during the price decline suggests some profit-taking pressure exists in the market, but overall selling pressure has not spiraled out of control.

2. Technical Indicator Interpretation

Ethereum’s technical indicators also display oversold characteristics. The 6-period RSI drops sharply from 79.64 to 28.58, already entering a deep oversold zone. The 12-period and 24-period RSIs are 41.18 and 46.40, respectively, and they are also relatively low.

MACD shows that the histogram has shifted from positive 3.63 to negative 0.20, indicating that bullish momentum is weakening. However, the MACD line is still above the zero axis, meaning the medium-term trend has not been fully broken.

Bollinger Bands indicate the price is currently trading above the mid-band at $2,694. The upper band is $2,742, and the lower band is $2,646. Trading above the mid-band suggests the market is still in a relatively strong condition.

In the KDJ indicators, the K value falls from 79.59 to 46.68, D is 64.86, and J drops to 10.32, showing a clear short-term oversold signal. Such extreme readings often imply demand for a technical rebound.

The composite technical indicators provide a bullish signal, with a historical win rate as high as 76.19%. The overall win rate is 76.60%. Among 15 factors, nine give bullish signals, five bearish signals, and one neutral. The bullish factor share is 60%, consistent with Bitcoin.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s current market sentiment is fairly complex. On one hand, ongoing inflows of institutional capital provide solid support. Data show that major entities have recently staked and added more than 53,000 ETH, reflecting strong confidence in Ethereum’s long-term value. At the same time, Ethereum spot ETFs have recorded weekly net inflows of over $624.2 million, and institutional participation continues to rise.

On the other hand, on-chain data indicate some selling pressure. More than 21,000 ETH has been transferred to centralized exchanges, increasing short-term supply pressure. In addition, after a recent $388 million security incident at a certain exchange, attackers are routing stolen Ethereum through decentralized paths, creating sell pressure in certain regions.

From the technical upside perspective, Ethereum is about to undergo the Glamsterdam upgrade, planned to be activated on the Sepolia testnet on October 6. This upgrade will significantly enhance network performance and cross-chain interoperability. Meanwhile, the integration of Chainlink CCIP 2.0 will also improve cross-chain throughput, further raising the infrastructure level of the Ethereum ecosystem.

On the regulatory front, although the clarity law for digital asset markets was stalled in the Senate, subsequent guidance from the SEC and CFTC provides the market with some degree of certainty. Especially, the clear stance that token buybacks and staking receipts do not constitute securities is positive for staking-based assets such as Ethereum.

Overall, Ethereum faces short-term technical oversold conditions, but sustained institutional inflows and the upcoming network upgrade provide strong support. It is recommended to watch the effectiveness of support around the $2,700 level. If that area can be defended and a rebound occurs with increased volume, there is a possibility of re-testing the $2,750 resistance level.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构持续增持五万三千枚，Glamsterdam升级在即提振信心

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千七百一十点九六美元，过去二十四小时呈现震荡回落走势。从小时级别K线观察，价格在二千七百三十八美元附近见顶后连续回调，最低触及二千六百七十二美元，目前在二千七百一十美元上方整理。

价格结构方面，以太坊在二千七百三十美元至二千七百五十美元区间形成短期压力，而二千六百七十美元至二千七百美元区间构成重要支撑。与比特币类似，以太坊的回调幅度相对温和，整体仍处于高位震荡格局。

成交量数据显示，最新一小时成交量为四千九百二十八万美元，较前期有所放大。在价格下跌过程中成交量的增加，表明市场存在一定的获利了结压力，但整体抛压并未失控。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的技术指标同样显示出超卖特征。RSI六周期指标从七十九点六四大幅下滑至二十八点五八，已经进入深度超卖区域。RSI十二周期和二十四周期分别为四十一一点一八和四十六点四零，同样处于相对低位。

MACD指标方面，柱状图从正值的三点六三转为负值的零点二零，显示多头动能正在衰减。不过MACD线仍处于零轴上方，中期趋势尚未完全破坏。

布林带指标显示，价格目前运行在中轨二千六百九十四美元上方，上轨为二千七百四十二美元，下轨为二千六百四十六美元。价格在布林带中轨上方运行，说明整体仍处于相对强势区间。

KDJ指标中，K值从七十九点五九回落至四十六点六八，D值为六十四点八六，J值降至十点三二，显示短期超卖信号明显。这种极端数值往往预示着技术性反弹的需求。

复合技术指标给出看涨信号，历史胜率高达百分之七十六点一九，整体胜率达到百分之七十六点六零。在十五个因子中，九个给出看涨信号，五个给出看跌信号，一个中性，看涨因子占比达到百分之六十，与比特币保持一致。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪较为复杂。一方面，机构资金的持续流入为价格提供了坚实支撑。数据显示，主要实体近期质押并增持了超过五万三千枚以太坊，显示出对以太坊长期价值的强烈信心。同时，以太坊现货ETF周度净流入超过六亿两千四百万美元，机构参与度持续提升。

另一方面，链上数据显示存在一定的抛压。超过两万一千枚以太坊被转移至中心化交易所，增加了短期供应压力。此外，近期某交易所遭受三点八八亿美元安全事件后，攻击者正在通过去中心化路由转换被盗的以太坊，这在局部地区形成了卖出压力。

技术面利好方面，以太坊即将迎来Glamsterdam升级，计划于十月六日在Sepolia测试网激活。此次升级将显著提升网络性能和跨链互操作性。同时，Chainlink CCIP 2.0的集成也将改善跨链吞吐量，进一步提升以太坊生态的基础设施水平。

监管层面，虽然数字资产市场 clarity 法案在参议院受阻，但SEC和CFTC的后续指导为市场提供了一定的确定性。特别是关于代币回购和质押凭证不构成证券的明确表态，对以太坊等质押型资产具有积极意义。

综合来看，以太坊短期面临技术性超卖，但机构资金的持续流入和即将到来的网络升级为价格提供了有力支撑。建议关注二千七百美元关口的支撑有效性，若能够守住该位置并出现放量反弹，则有望重新测试二千七百五十美元上方阻力。

ePBS enters the next round of testing arrangements｜Timely payload delivery is not a matter of executing already-validated work｜Before ETH confirms at 2752, I’ll wait first

My stance is to support the protocol’s development, but first distinguish between “getting the data on time” and “the execution being effective.” I’m not treating the expansion roadmap as an immediate buy-in, nor am I calling the reshuffling of the validation phase a cancellation of validation. For now, I’m still holding a zero position.

The facts on the ground: The Ethereum Foundation’s page shows that on September 28 it published a Glamsterdam testnet announcement. The upgrade includes separating the proposer and builder within the protocol—i.e., ePBS. Sepolia is planned to activate at 13:53:36 UTC on October 6, which is 21:53:36 Beijing time. The date for Hoodi vs. the mainnet has not yet been decided. The key new observation is that the responsibilities of building and validating are distinct; the mainnet expansion cannot be inferred by reusing the testnet gas parameters. [Official announcement](https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/09/17/glamsterdam-testnet-announcement)。

Cross-check the EIP-7732 specification: Builders first provide signing commitments, and then the corresponding execution payload is made public. A committee of validators then forms to assess payload timeliness—confirming whether the payload was publicly available on time, whether the block hash corresponds, and whether the observed blob data is usable. The specification is explicit: the committee’s responsibility itself does not require validating the execution payload; execution validation is deferred to subsequent beacon block validation. The EIP page is still marked as “Review,” so you can’t simply announce that the mainnet has switched based on its numbering alone. [Original text](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7732)。

How does this affect the crypto market? My mechanism-based view is that how the critical path is divided will affect node time budgeting, block-building coordination, and dependence on external intermediary components. Reducing congestion in critical stages has infrastructure significance, but real-world effectiveness still needs to be verified via client adaptation, test results, and mainnet implementation. It does not guarantee every transaction succeeds immediately, nor does it guarantee that frontrunning, slippage, and transaction-ordering problems will simply disappear.

For ordinary users, the easiest misinterpretation is treating “proof of data availability” as “my token swap has already succeeded.” The committee’s timeliness decision, execution results, final confirmation, and platform crediting are different layers of state. When checking a transaction, you must look at the receipts from the correct network and the execution outcome. A wallet showing “submitted” does not mean the platform has already credited your funds. This is the verification discipline required when using the protocol. It does not claim that this round has been tested and that funds have already been swapped.

Test outcomes must be verified; without evidence of funds, don’t write institutional accumulation; don’t attach irrelevant tags.

Market reality: As of 22:58 Beijing time, Binance ETH/USDT is at 2715.93. Rolling 24-hour change is +1.913%, low 2652.20, high 2748.60—still within the window. There’s no evidence that the trend is caused by the ePBS announcement. 2752 is merely a human confirmation line, not a target price promised by the protocol.

If it were my own trading, I would not participate and would keep a zero position; I’d only consider unleveraged spot longs. I’d only enter with up to 0.3% of total funds if the full hour closes above 2752, a pullback holds between 2742 and 2752, and actual platform trades and withdrawals are functioning normally. Then: 2770 halves the position; 2790 closes the entire position. Hard stop loss at 2725, or if two consecutive hours close below 2742, I fully close. If it breaks down below 2650 before triggering, I cancel; if it jumps to the target, I don’t chase or try to recover losses. If official changes to responsibilities or schedule occur, channel anomalies arise, or the breakout fails, I withdraw the corresponding judgment. If it’s not triggered, I don’t write any trade profit.

一手事实：以太坊基金会页面显示九月二十八日发布Glamsterdam测试网公告，升级内容包括协议内置的提议者与构建者分离，即ePBS。Sepolia拟十月六日13:53:36 UTC激活，北京时间当晚21:53:36；Hoodi与主网日期尚未决定。这里的新增观察是构建与验证职责，不重复用测试网Gas参数推算主网扩容。[官方公告](https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/09/17/glamsterdam-testnet-announcement)。

交叉核对EIP-7732规范：构建者先给出签名承诺，随后公开对应执行载荷；一组验证者组成载荷及时性委员会，确认载荷是否及时公开、区块哈希是否对应，以及所见blob数据是否可用。规范明确，这项委员会职责本身不要求验证执行载荷，执行验证被安排到后续信标区块验证时。规范页面仍标Review，不能只凭编号宣布主网已经切换。[规范原文](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7732)。

为什么影响加密市场？我的机制判断是，关键路径如何分工，会影响节点时间预算、区块构建协作与对外部中间环节的依赖。减少关键阶段的工作拥挤，有基础设施意义，但真实效果需要客户端适配、测试结果及主网实施来验证。它不保证每笔交易立即成功，更不保证抢跑、滑点和交易排序问题从此消失。

对普通用户，最容易误读的是把“数据可用”的证明当作“我的换币已经成功”。委员会及时性判断、执行结果、最终确认和平台入账，是不同层次的状态。查交易还要看正确网络的回执与执行结果；钱包显示已提交，不等于接收平台已入账。这是使用协议时的核验纪律，不声称本轮做过实测或已经转币。

测试效果须核验，无资金证据不写机构增持，不挂无关标签。

市场实际表现：北京时间22:58，币安ETH/USDT为2715.93，滚动二十四小时涨1.913%，低2652.20、高2748.60，仍在窗口内。没有证据证明走势由ePBS公告造成。2752只是人为确认线，不是协议承诺的目标价。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与、仓位零，只考虑无杠杆现货多。完整小时收在2752上方，回踩2742至2752守住，且实际平台交易提现正常，才用总资金最多0.3%试仓；2770减半、2790全平；2725硬止损，或连续两小时2742下方全平。触发前跌破2650取消，跳到目标不追、不补亏损仓。官方改动职责或排期、通道异常、突破失败，撤回相应判断；未触发不写成交盈利。

title: Vitalik diz que a Ethereum não é mais só uma blockchain
subTitle:
No último sábado, Vitalik Buterin publicou o texto que pode redefinir como você entende a Ethereum. A frase que ele soltou resume tudo: "Não é mais só uma blockchain. É um híbrido."
Se você acha que já sabe o que é a Ethereum, esse artigo vai te fazer repensar.
O fim de uma era
Buterin aponta a Hegota, prevista para 2027, como o último upgrade "normal" da rede — o último que alguém de 2015 ainda reconheceria. A partir dali, a Ethereum entra numa fase diferente: menos blockchain tradicional, mais um sistema híbrido apoiado em provas criptográficas.
Na prática, os nós da rede vão parar de reexecutar cada transação para conferir se está tudo certo. Em vez disso, vão verificar provas compactas (SNARKs) que atestam que o trabalho foi feito corretamente. Isso, combinado com a amostragem de dados (PeerDAS), permite rodar um nó com muito menos hardware.
Privacidade deixa de ser extra
Outro ponto central: privacidade sai do "modo opcional" e entra na arquitetura. O plano inclui provas de conhecimento zero para transações e contas, além de onion routing e mixnets na camada de rede. A ideia é que aplicações específicas tenham privacidade forte por padrão.
As metas para 2030
Slots de 4 a 8 segundos (hoje: cerca de 17s)Finalidade em 8 a 32 segundos (hoje: cerca de 200s para 12 confirmações)Construção de blocos dividida entre múltiplos participantes, não mais um único proposerResistência a computação quântica
Vitalik é claro: a Ethereum nunca vai ter a velocidade de um servidor comum. Mas a infraestrutura construída em cima dela pode parecer tão rápida quanto.
Por que isso importa agora
Esse texto não é ficção. Ele é a versão em linguagem simples do Strawmap, o cronograma técnico que a Ethereum Foundation já vem seguindo. Ou seja: não é "se vai acontecer", é "como vai acontecer".
Para quem investe ou constrói na rede, a leitura é direta: a tese de longo prazo da Ethereum ficou mais clara essa semana. Vale acompanhar de perto os próximos forks — principalmente a Glamsterdam, ainda em 2026, e a Hegota, em 2027.
Gostou da análise? Segue o perfil pra não perder os próximos updates sobre Ethereum, Bitcoin e o mercado cripto — chega notícia nova todo dia por aqui.

This means the AI industry is moving from the lab to the market—technical deployment is no longer the main problem. Impact on the market
In the short term, a corporate AI surge may boost sentiment around related stocks and cryptocurrencies. But the long-term impact depends on whether OpenAI also gets into cryptocurrencies. If it doesn’t, then it’s only positive for the AI sector. If it really does, it could completely reshape the interaction between AI and Crypto. title: 🛑 El error silencioso que liquida al 90% de los traders (Y cómo evitarlo)
subTitle:
La mayoría de los traders principiantes pasan meses buscando la "estrategia perfecta", el indicador mágico o la señal infalible. Sin embargo, la razón principal por la que pierden su capital no es la falta de análisis técnico: es la mala gestión del riesgo.

Si quieres sobrevivir y ser rentable en el mercado cripto a largo plazo, estas son las 3 reglas de oro que debes aplicar hoy mismo:

1. La regla del 1-2% por operación
Nunca arriesgues más del 1% al 2% de tu capital total en una sola posición.

Ejemplo práctico: Si tu cuenta tiene $500, tu pérdida máxima permitida por trade no debería superar los $5 a $10.

Arriesgar el 10% o 20% por operación significa que una racha negativa de 4 o 5 operaciones destruirá la mitad de tu cuenta, haciendo que recuperarte sea matemáticamente casi imposible.

2. Relación Riesgo/Beneficio (R:R) mínima de 1:2
Antes de abrir cualquier orden, calcula dónde estará tu Stop Loss (SL) y tu Take Profit (TP).

Busca siempre que tu beneficio potencial sea al menos el doble de lo que estás arriesgando.

¿Por qué funciona? Si ejecutas 10 operaciones con una relación 1:2 y solo ganas 4 de ellas (un 40% de tasa de acierto), aún así serás rentable.

3. El apalancamiento es una herramienta de tamaño, no de avaricia
El apalancamiento elevado (20x, 50x, 100x) reduce drásticamente el margen de error y liquida posiciones ante la volatilidad normal del mercado.

Consejo: Define el tamaño de tu posición en función de tu Stop Loss en dólares, no del apalancamiento que uses. Si ajustas tu tamaño correctamente, operar a 5x o 20x no debería cambiar el monto total que arriesgas.

💡 Conclusión
El trading rentable no se trata de adivinar hacia dónde irá el mercado en la próxima vela, sino de controlar las pérdidas cuando te equivocas y maximizar las ganancias cuando tienes razón.

Preserva tu capital primero; las ganancias vendrán como consecuencia del proceso.

💬 ¿Cuál es la regla de gestión de riesgo que más te ha costado disciplinar en tu trading? Déjala en los comentarios. 👇

Democrats’ rejection was not random. Behind it lies an intense bipartisan struggle over the path of digital-asset regulation. On one hand, progressives want to legislate quickly. 📰 Why Adam Back's empire is suddenly teetering? The $320M hacking case is just the tip of the iceberg  

Bitcoin pioneer Adam Back’s legendary career has been hit by a double blow: the IPO of the linked Bitcoin reserves company failed, and his mining firm then suffered a massive $320M hacking incident. These two events reveal that his seemingly solid position in the crypto world is facing serious challenges—especially in light of heightened volatility across the industry in recent times.  

Why is this news important?  
As a key figure and early Bitcoin cryptographer, Adam Back’s identity is historically significant; his technical contributions have even been cited in the Bitcoin white paper. But this crisis exposes the vulnerability of individuals within a massive industry ecosystem—no matter how much industry prestige they have, they can’t fully eliminate systemic risks. What may lie behind these events is a shrinking opportunity for regulatory arbitrage in the crypto sector, upgraded hacking tactics, and ongoing operational pressure on early startup teams. Similar to recent cases like FTX, it points to a fundamental issue: decentralized enterprises must address core governance and security problems.  

Impact on the market  
In the short term, negative news about such well-known figures and their companies can reinforce the idea that “there are no eternal kings,” especially by fueling concerns about the stability of mining firms. 以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期叠加ETF资金推动，短期警惕超买回调

2026年9月29日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月二十九日下午，以太坊现货价格报二千七百二十七美元，过去二十四小时经历了先扬后抑的走势。从小时K线来看，价格从二千七百零八美元起步，最高触及二千七百四十八美元，随后小幅回落至二千七百三十美元附近。最近五个一小时的收盘价分别为二千七百一十七美元、二千七百一十四美元、二千七百三十二美元、二千七百三十六美元和二千七百三十美元，整体呈现冲高后高位盘整的形态。

以太坊本轮上涨的核心驱动力来自三个方面。首先，现货以太坊ETF上周录得超过六亿二千万美元的净流入，机构配置需求持续旺盛。其次，BitMine等机构持续增持以太坊，其持仓已突破六百万枚，价值约一百七十二亿美元，彰显了对以太坊长期价值的坚定信心。第三，以太坊开发者已将Glamsterdam升级安排在十月六日登陆Sepolia测试网，技术迭代预期为价格提供了额外支撑。不过需要注意的是，近期有链上监测发现约两万枚以太坊被转入中心化交易所，叠加黑客将窃取的以太坊通过去中心化协议兑换为比特币的操作，短期卖压不容忽视。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千七百二十一点八八，位于二十五小时均线二千六百九十一点八三上方，短期均线保持多头排列。九十九小时均线报二千六百八十八点三四，价格运行在所有主要均线上方，中期上升趋势完好。指数移动均线同样确认多头格局，七小时EMA报二千七百二十点四七，与简单均线形成有效共振。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千七百四十二美元，中轨二千六百九十四美元，下轨二千六百四十六美元。当前价格已触及甚至短暂突破布林带上轨，表明短期动能强劲。但价格持续贴近上轨运行时，往往意味着短期超买状态加剧，需警惕回踩中轨的技术性调整需求。

MACD指标方面，DIF线报十三点九一，信号线报八点二三，柱状图维持在五点六八的正值区域。虽然柱状图较前一小时的六点一九有所收窄，但MACD线仍在信号线上方运行，多头趋势尚未被破坏。RSI指标显示，六周期RSI从八十一的高位回落至七十点九四，十二周期RSI报六十五点八三，二十四周期RSI报五十九点八九。短周期RSI从超买区域的快速回落，暗示短期获利盘正在兑现收益。

KDJ指标中K值八十一四九、D值七十六点五七、J值九十一三四，三线均处于偏高区域，但J值已从接近一百的极值回落，短期调整信号初现。威廉指标报负十九点零六，同样从超买区域回撤。综合来看，以太坊技术面整体偏多，但多项短期指标已发出过热预警，建议关注二千七百美元整数关口的支撑力度。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪目前处于乐观与谨慎并存的状态。从积极面来看，ETF资金持续流入和Glamsterdam升级预期为市场注入了强劲信心，山寨币季节指数已从四十八上升至六十四，资金开始从比特币向以太坊等主流山寨币轮动。从风险面来看，短期RSI超买和鲸鱼向交易所转入大额资产的行为，提示近期可能出现技术性回调。

生态层面，以太坊网络持续扩展应用场景，Chainlink CCIP集成将跨链确认时间缩短至二十四秒以内，显著提升了网络实用性。同时，SEC和CFTC在CLARITY法案参议院未通过后发布了新的加密指导方针，明确代币回购不自动构成证券，为以太坊生态的合规发展提供了更清晰的政策框架。

综合判断，以太坊短期在二千七百至二千七百五十美元区间震荡的概率较大。若能有效消化超买压力并站稳二千七百五十美元上方，后续有望挑战二千八百美元关口；若鲸鱼抛售压力加大，则可能回踩二千六百九十美元附近的均线支撑。中期来看，Glamsterdam升级的顺利推进和ETF资金的持续流入将继续为以太坊提供上行动力。

At present, BTC/ETH are in a relatively safe range, but AI regulatory risk hangs over like a sword. 📰 Why Do IBIT ETF Inflows Make Institutional Demand a Mystery? CoinShares Is Being Too Cautious?

CoinShares’ latest report shows that even though IBIT spot Bitcoin ETFs have continued to see inflows, based on analyzing market makers’ basis trade data, they believe these inflows don’t necessarily mean investors are betting on further upside for Bitcoin prices. This suggests institutional capital entering the market may have other purposes—such as hedging or allocation—rather than simply pure bullish speculation on a bull run. This adds even more uncertainty to BTC’s current move around $84,364.99.

Why is this news important?
As a standardized channel for institutional allocation of Bitcoin, IBIT ETF fund flows have long been closely watched by the market. But CoinShares’ findings highlight two key issues: first, the logic behind institutional investors’ behavior in ETFs may be more complex than we assume—they may not all be straightforward Bitcoin longs; second, there may not be a simple proportional relationship between ETF inflows and Bitcoin price increases. Against the market backdrop where BTC/ETH’s 24h gains are 0.96%/1.75% respectively, this is especially worth vigilance. Why? Because it implies that the traditional bullish indicator of institutional demand may be getting distorted.

Market impact
In the short term, this conclusion could dampen market expectations that ETF inflows will drive a bull market. But the medium-to-long term impact could be more complicated. If institutions are indeed using ETFs to allocate to Bitcoin, but not based on expectations of price上涨, then when Bitcoin prices pull back, ETF net inflows could accelerate—creating a negative feedback loop. Conversely, if institutions are only using ETFs for hedging or short-term arbitrage, then once market sentiment shifts, ETF outflows could be more severe than expected. This means when we look at ETF data, we need to focus on the underlying motives—not just the magnitude. Has anything like this happened before? During the 2008 financial crisis, many institutions conducted arbitrage through physical commodity ETFs, only to suffer massive losses when commodities collapsed.

Trading/positioning idea
💡 In the short term, there is clear pressure above BTC $84,364.99. If institutions are truly using ETFs for non-speculative allocation, this level may be difficult to break. But if subsequent data shows a clear positive correlation between ETF inflows and Bitcoin price increases, then this view would be invalidated.

If regulators suddenly tighten ETF approvals, this view would also be invalidated.

IBIT ETF作为机构配置比特币的标准化渠道，其资金流向一直被市场密切关注。但CoinShares的发现揭示了两个关键问题：第一，机构投资者在ETF里的行为逻辑可能比我们想象的更复杂，他们未必都是纯粹的比特币多头；第二，ETF流入和比特币价格上涨之间，未必存在简单的正比关系。这在当前BTC/ETH 24h涨幅分别为0.96%/1.75%的市场背景下，尤其值得警惕。为什么？因为这意味着机构需求这个传统看涨指标，可能正在失真。

Take a close look at this chart (AKD/USDT perpetual contract). This is a classic textbook example of a pump-and-dump scheme (often orchestrated by coordinated "signal" groups or scammers):
 * The Trap: The price gets artificially pumped up in a massive, vertical spike to lure in unsuspecting buyers experiencing FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out).
 * The Dump: Moments after reaching the peak, the price crashes just as violently, wiping out portfolios instantly.
 * The Reality: Scammers or insider whales buy low, hype up the coin on social media, dump their bags onto retail investors at the top, and leave everyone else holding worthless assets.

How to protect yourself:
 * 🛑 Avoid FOMO chasing: If a coin spikes vertically out of nowhere without organic growth or news, stay away.
 * 🛑 Ignore "Guaranteed Profit" Groups: Never trust random Telegram, Discord, or social media groups telling you to buy a specific low-cap coin at a set time.

以太坊市场深度分析：两千七百美元上方的攻守之道

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报两千七百二十五美元，过去数小时呈现震荡上行态势。从小时K线来看，以太坊在两千七百零六美元获得支撑后逐步攀升，最高触及两千七百四十八美元，整体运行在上升通道中。

以太坊近期的强势表现得益于多重利好因素。首先，美国现货以太坊ETF连续获得机构资金青睐，上周净流入超过二十三万一千枚ETH，显示出机构对以太坊生态的长期看好。其次，BitMine将国库持仓增加了一万七千三百六十二枚ETH，SharpLink Gaming额外质押了四万两千零七十四枚ETH，企业级买盘的持续入场为价格提供了有力支撑。

更为重要的是，以太坊即将在十月六日迎来Glamsterdam升级，该升级将引入提议者至构建者分离机制和修订后的Gas定价模型。这一技术升级被市场普遍视为利好，推动了前瞻性的买入情绪。全球DeFi总锁仓量在第三季度回升百分之三十八至约九百五十二亿美元，其中以太坊以约五百三十六亿美元的TVL继续领跑，展现出生态系统的强大活力。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报两千七百一十八，二十五小时均线报两千六百九十，九十九小时均线报两千六百八十八。三条均线呈现完美的多头排列，短期均线持续上穿中长期均线，价格稳定运行在所有均线上方，技术形态较为健康。

MACD指标表现亮眼，MACD线报十二点九一，信号线报六点七九，柱状图报六点一一。MACD线持续位于信号线上方，柱状图保持正值且呈扩大趋势，表明多头动能正在逐步增强。这是近期最积极的技術信号之一。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI报八十点八三，十二周期RSI报六十九点七零，二十四周期RSI报六十一点六零。短期RSI已进入偏高区域，接近超买水平，这意味着短期内可能出现技术性回调。但从中长期来看，RSI的强势表现反映出市场买盘力量充沛。

布林带上轨报两千七百三十七，中轨报两千六百九十二，下轨报两千六百四十七。价格运行在接近上轨的位置，布林带呈开口扩张态势，暗示波动率正在上升，后续可能出现较大幅度的方向性运动。

KDJ指标中，K值报八十一点七零，D值报七十三点九六，J值报九十七点二零。J值接近一百的极端高位，短期超买信号明显。但在强势上涨行情中，KDJ高位钝化是正常现象，投资者不宜仅凭此指标就贸然做空。

从因子统计来看，十五个因子中仅三个发出做多信号，十二个发出做空信号。复合指标发出做空信号，整体胜率为百分之七十六。虽然短期因子偏空，但价格实际走势却在上涨，这种背离暗示空头因子可能正在失效，市场实际动能强于指标显示。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪整体偏向乐观。机构资金的持续流入、即将到来的技术升级、以及DeFi生态的复苏，共同构建了较为坚实的看多基础。山寨币季节指数的回升也表明，市场风险偏好正在改善，资金开始从比特币向以太坊等主流山寨币轮动。

然而，需要警惕的风险因素同样不容忽视。链上数据显示，大户近期向交易所转入超过两万一千四百四十五枚ETH，存在潜在的抛售压力。此外，某大型安全事件的攻击者将盗取的资金兑换为ETH并通过去中心化协议进行跨链转移，这一事件可能带来短期的市场不安。

展望后市，以太坊在两千七百美元上方的整理蓄势值得关注。如果价格能够有效突破两千七百五十美元的阻力位，后续看向两千九百美元甚至三千美元并非不可能。反之，若跌破两千七百美元支撑，则可能回测两千六百五十美元附近。十月六日的Glamsterdam升级将是近期最重要的催化剂，投资者可提前布局但需控制仓位。

title: Peluang Ethereum ($ETH) Tembus $3.000: Menunggangi Tren Reversal dan Sentimen Makro
subTitle:
Peta pergerakan pasar aset kripto kembali menunjukkan sinyal pemulihan yang menjanjikan. Dari sekian banyak aset yang menjadi sorotan, Ethereum ($ETH) menjadi salah satu yang paling menarik perhatian para pelaku pasar saat ini. Setelah melewati fase konsolidasi panjang yang melelahkan, ETH kini mulai membangun pondasi kokoh untuk keluar dari tekanan jual jangka pendek.
Hingga 29 September 2026, Ethereum berhasil mempertahankan posisinya di zona psikologis penting dan diperdagangkan di atas level 2.700 USDT. Rebound ini memicu pertanyaan krusial di kalangan trader: apakah ini awal dari reli berkelanjutan menuju akhir tahun, atau sekadar pemulihan sesaat (relief rally)? Mari kita bedah dari sudut pandang fundamental dan teknikal.
1. Pemicu Utama di Balik Geliat Harga ETH
Ada beberapa alasan kuat mengapa Ethereum kembali mendapatkan momentum beli yang agresif dalam beberapa waktu terakhir:
• Kembalinya Likuiditas Institusi: Arus masuk bersih (net inflows) ke instrumen Spot Ethereum ETF mencatatkan angka yang impresif dengan total lebih dari $172 juta. Masuknya dana segar ini membuktikan bahwa minat pemodal besar terhadap aset Web3 terbesar ini masih sangat masif.
• Jaringan Layer-2 yang Kian Dominan: Ethereum tetap menjadi penguasa mutlak untuk ekosistem Keuangan Terdesentralisasi (DeFi) dan tren Tokenisasi Aset Nyata (RWA). Lonjakan aktivitas di jaringan Layer-2 seperti Base, Arbitrum, dan Optimism secara tidak langsung terus memperkuat nilai guna ekonomi dari token ETH itu sendiri.
• Dukungan Iklim Makro Ekonomi: Rencana penurunan suku bunga lanjutan oleh bank sentral global memberikan sentimen positif bagi pasar keuangan. Aset berisiko tinggi seperti kripto cenderung diuntungkan karena likuiditas di pasar global menjadi lebih longgar.
$ETH 
2. Peta Teknikal: Struktur Harga dan Level Krusial
Melihat grafik harga, Ethereum menunjukkan struktur reversal yang cukup rapi setelah berhasil mematahkan tren turun pada bulan sebelumnya.
• Resisten Target Akhir Tahun ($2.800 – $3.000): Benteng pertahanan terdekat yang harus ditaklukkan berada di area $2.800. Jika harga mampu ditutup di atas level tersebut dengan volume perdagangan yang meyakinkan, ETH memiliki peluang besar untuk menguji level psikologis $3.000 menjelang akhir kuartal ini.
• Batas Pertahanan Bawah ($2.550 – $2.600): Selama terjadi koreksi sehat, area antara $2.550 hingga $2.600 wajib dipertahankan oleh para pembeli (bulls). Jika harga tetap bertahan di atas batas ini, maka struktur tren naik (uptrend) jangka pendek dinilai masih sangat aman.
$BNB 
3. Prospek Pasar dan Skenario Jangka Menengah
Para pengamat pasar merumuskan dua skenario utama terkait ke mana arah ETH akan bergerak hingga penutupan tahun 2026:
• Skenario Optimis: Dengan asumsi akumulasi korporasi terus berjalan konsisten, beberapa proyeksi institusional menargetkan ETH bisa merangkak hingga ke area $4.000. Untuk mencapai skenario ini, ETH membutuhkan pertumbuhan rata-rata sekitar 14% di setiap bulannya.
• Skenario Konservatif: Jika tekanan jual dari investor jangka pendek di area resisten atas terlalu kuat, ETH kemungkinan besar akan bergerak menyamping (sideways) di rentang $2.600 hingga $2.900 untuk mengumpulkan tenaga baru sebelum reli jangka panjang berikutnya dimulai.
Kesimpulan Akhir
Ethereum ($ETH) saat ini sedang berada dalam momentum krusial untuk menentukan arah tren besarnya. Keberhasilan bertahan di atas 2.700 USDT adalah langkah awal yang solid, namun pasar masih memerlukan stabilitas volume beli untuk menembus tembok $3.000. Strategi terbaik saat ini adalah memantau pergerakan arus dana ETF serta kekuatan area support terdekat.

这周比特币上演了一出大戏：价格直接涨了40%以上，把黄金、美股这些老大哥都甩在身后。NS3.AI的数据显示，黄金单日就跌了接近4%。比特币这波拉升，让市场开始猜测，它是不是真的要奔着10万美元大关去了。这对加密圈和整个投资界来说，都是一个重磅消息。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因，说白了就是避险情绪和投资轮动。当传统资产黄金在关键时刻掉链子，资金就往更灵活、可能带来更高回报的地方跑。比特币作为数字黄金，这种属性被无限放大了。而且，最近加密圈的利好消息接二连三（比如之前说的监管松绑传闻），可能也刺激了买家。这跟之前"美联储加息预期打压风险资产"的周期，形成鲜明对比，意味着市场可能正在寻找新的避风港。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH来说，短期情绪肯定是极强的看涨信号。比特币已经站上了84,401这个关键位置，如果能稳住，后面冲击100万美元的可能性就大增。对市场格局，这表明机构投资者可能在重新评估加密资产的风险收益比。资金可能从科技股或者其他高估值资产里流出，转战比特币这种具有替代性的资产。历史上看，类似事件（比如2008年金融危机时黄金大涨）之后，比特币往往能迎来爆发期，但这次的背景是AI热潮和宏观利率环境不同，需要具体分析。

操作思路
我认为，如果比特币能守住84,401这个位置，继续看涨冲向90,000的可能性就很大。但这个判断有失效条件：如果美国通胀数据再超预期，或者突然出现新的监管风险（比如SEC正式封杀某个交易所），这个逻辑就立刻作废了。现在入场，更像是在赌一个长期趋势，短期波动可能会很剧烈。

🤔 Why did Biden’s former Treasury Secretary suddenly give Crypto a high score? What signal does the Citi x Coinbase thing actually send?

Citi and Coinbase have started automatically converting Stablecoins to dollars for institutional clients. In short: previously, institutions that used Stablecoins had a harder time turning their crypto into real money; now, working with major banks makes it easier for them to swap crypto for cash. This is a major breakthrough for getting crypto accepted by traditional finance.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that crypto wants to truly integrate into the existing financial system. Before, exchanging for coins was cumbersome for institutions; now, partnering with big banks shows that crypto is gradually shedding the “not grounded in reality” label. Regulators have also taken a more relaxed stance on Stablecoins recently, giving this development the chance to come at the right time.

Market impact
In the short term, sentiment for BTC and ETH is likely to be positive. ETH has surged in the past few days, and this is a catalyst. In the long run, if Stablecoins become more tightly integrated with traditional finance, some demand for BTC as a store of value could be diverted. But in the short run, institutions can operate more conveniently, which lowers the entry threshold for funds to flow into the crypto world.

💡 I think this move is more impactful for ETH, since Coinbase is a pillar of the Ethereum ecosystem. Whether ETH can hold the $2,743 level is key to validating how strong this news really is. If it breaks below $2,700, it would suggest that institutional clients care more about short-term risk hedging, and the upside from this news would be discounted. If BTC can stay above $84,000, it would indicate that large capital is waiting for this kind of integration opportunity to enter.

If, in the future, there is a major tightening of regulation—such as the U.S. taxing Stablecoins or restricting them—then this judgment would be invalid.

📰 Why does the ECB need to consider AI interactions in the digital euro pilot?

I just mentioned this the other day, and now there’s new progress. The European Central Bank not only wants to test digital euro payment functions, but also plans to use AI agents to explore future use cases. The experiments will run from next year through June of next year. This round of testing will split the project into two parts—practical and theoretical—but the core goal is to figure out whether AI can work together with the digital euro.

The ECB has suddenly made room for AI, which means the integration of digital currency and AI is taking another step forward. Behind the scenes, Europe wants to make the digital euro smarter through technology—think of things like automated transfers and intelligent robo-advisors. In plain terms, they want to seize the high ground of AI application scenarios in the era of digital currency. Recently, the U.S. has also been working on its own digital dollar, but it doesn’t seem to have figured out how to connect it with AI yet. The ECB’s move looks a bit fast.

Market impact
This news could have an even bigger effect on ETH. Technically, ETH is basically a testing ground for both AI and DeFi. With the ECB doing this, it could boost ETH sentiment in the short term. But in the long run, this is more of a policy signal—meaning the digital currency space may gain another powerful AI player. Specifically for price: if ETH can hold the $2,700 level, that would suggest the market accepts the ECB’s technical approach, and it may continue to test the $2,743 target. But if it breaks below that point, it would indicate that expectations for AI integration are being weakened, and you should be cautious once it’s under $2,743.

💡 I’m neutral to mildly bullish on ETH, because this time the ECB action is official, not some small company’s experiment. However, if the AI test results are too poor (for example, frequent errors), this bullish takeaway will quickly turn into a bearish one. If, during the test, ETH drops to $2,743, then this judgment is no longer valid.

The forum topic #BitgetHackerFailsToMoveStolenFunds shows 4096 views and 171 discussions, which is up compared to the previous round. However, this article does not repeat the “refusing exchange isn’t a freeze” conclusion; instead, it checks the actual boundaries between today’s ETH withdrawal schedule and the receiving network.

Facts are based on the official announcement: Bitget’s September 26 staged restoration schedule lists ETH and Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism for September 29 at 08:00 UTC, which converts to 16:00 Beijing time today. This time has arrived, but it does not mean I have individually verified every channel has been restored. The announcement’s requirement is to follow the withdrawal availability that the platform directly displays. The security tracking notice also states that the investigation is still ongoing, so you cannot treat the schedule table as proof that the case is closed. [Restoration schedule](https://www.bitget.com/support/articles/12560603896110).

The key point is that the name “ETH” being the same does not mean you are receiving balances from the same chain. ethereum.org explains that transferring ETH between the mainnet and Arbitrum is done via bridges, and it explicitly states that different chains cannot communicate natively and freely. Even if the address looks identical, it still cannot replace the receiving platform’s confirmation that the network and assets are supported. A mainnet deposit address does not automatically mean all other networks listed in the announcement are supported. [Bridge mechanism](https://ethereum.org/bridges/).

Why does this affect trades? My view is that the availability of exit channels affects fund scheduling and exposure to risk, but the restoration of withdrawals itself is not an added ETH buying order. Choosing a network that appears cheaper—if the receiving side doesn’t support it—may save on fees but lead to trouble with automatic crediting. Adding a temporary bridge also increases the uncertainty of contracts, operations, and settlement time. This is execution risk, not an indicator of future coin price.

When organizing assets, I will first verify the coin type, both parties’ networks, and the deposit/credit rules from the official entry point. If a transfer is necessary, I will use a small amount for validation first. I won’t sign unknown permissions or hand over mnemonic phrases. This is a conditional process—I do not claim that funds have been sent out or recovered.

What the market has already shown: At 19:56 Beijing time, Binance ETH/USDT is 2734.92, up 2.554% over the rolling 24 hours, ranging from 2651.68 to 2738.51. The price is near the upper edge of the window, but I have no evidence that the entire rally can be attributed to the withdrawal arrangements. 2742 is a human confirmation threshold, not a price commitment by the platform.

If I were trading on my own: I would not participate, my position would be zero. I would only consider unleveraged spot longs, not shorts. If the hourly close is above 2742, then pull back and hold 2735 to 2742, and—importantly—the trading platform and the exit path I use have already been verified as normal, then I would deploy up to at most 0.3% of total funds. If it breaks below 2650 before triggering, I cancel—no chasing the target, and I do not average down to cover losses.

If the platform delays restoration, the receiving chain isn’t supported, the official investigation changes my understanding of the risks, or the bridge fails, then I would overturn the decision to participate. Stop-loss orders carry slippage risk; everything above is a conditional plan only, with no implication of executed trades or profits.

Raydium on Solana is currently the only DEX that has truly commercialized and implemented tokenized equities. The sharp revenue spike last week suggests users are accepting this new asset allocation approach, which could have a far-reaching impact on the diversification of DeFi assets.

📰 为什么 Raydium 的 tokenized equities 让 Solana DEX 收入暴涨？

Raydium 在 Solana 上线 tokenized equities 功能后，上周收入创下 2025 年中以来的最高纪录。这意味着 Solana 最大的 DEX 开始大规模承接代币化股票带来的交易流量，但同时也引发了监管机构对这类创新业务模式的关注。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Solana 的 Raydium 是目前唯一真正将 tokenized equities 商业化落地的 DEX。这类功能允许投资者用原生代币（如 SOL）抵押换取上市公司的股权代币，这本质上是把传统金融的股票做市模式搬到了链上。上周收入暴涨，意味着用户接受了这种新的资产配置方式，对整个 DeFi 的资产多样化有深远影响。

对市场的影响
首先看 SOL。Raydium 收入暴涨直接利好 SOL，因为用户需要用 SOL 扣押获得代币化股票。理论上，如果这个模式持续，将提振 SOL 的需求。其次对 BTC/ETH 价格，这种新型资产增加了加密市场容量，但监管风险是悬顶之剑。如果美国 SEC 把这类业务定性为证券发行，所有 DEX 都可能面临合规重审，这会直接打击市场情绪。

操作思路
💡 Raydium 的 tokenized equities 短期内是利好 SOL，但要看 SOL 能否站稳 $125 美元。如果监管消息突然发酵，这个逻辑立刻作废。这意味着 SOL 在 $120-130 区间有博弈空间，但任何监管动作都可能让多头迅速离场。

Give up some conspiracy theories.

Market logic itself does not need conspiracy theories.

Whether it’s Wall Street shouting, or overseas big Vs shouting about top assets, there is ultimately only one question: can it create value, can it make money.

No one thing—shouting that people are getting tricked into boarding a train, shouting that the crypto world must go to zero, and shouting that Bitcoin will reach $1 million—these three things by themselves don’t matter.

Bitcoin has reached where it is today not because any one country, any one institution, or a group of people conspired to push it forward. Instead, it’s because the crypto industry’s overall scale, technical capabilities, and potential value have already been re-priced by the market over the long term.

So don’t think so much about all kinds of nonsense.

And you don’t need to be too concerned about whether the Chinese government needs it or whether the U.S. government needs it.

translatedData.content:
That night, I can never forget.

At 3:17 a.m., the blue light from his phone screen shone on Xiao Lin’s face. He stared at the K-line chart, his eyes bloodshot, and hadn’t closed his eyes in six straight hours.

Three months ago, Xiao Lin was still a well-behaved programmer earning 20,000 yuan a month, saving 100,000 yuan for a down payment. Everything changed on that Friday night. He saw a post in Binance Plaza—someone claimed that with futures he made 800,000 yuan in a single month.

“From 100,000 to 80,000—just 20x leverage.” That number drilled into Xiao Lin’s mind like a poison.

He opened a position with 5,000 yuan, going long on CELO with 20x leverage. That day, CELO rose from 0.089 to 0.11, and he made 3,000 yuan. 3,000 yuan—he couldn’t earn that much in a whole day at work. In that moment, he felt he’d found the shortcut to life.

Then came adding to the position: 10,000, 30,000, 50,000—until finally he put every last bit of his savings, all 100,000 yuan, into it. 20x leverage, going long on CELO. He set a goal for himself: when it hit 0.15, he’d stop, and he could profit 66,000.

“I’ll stop after I’ve earned enough for the down payment.” He told himself that.

CELO did rise to 0.119, and Xiao Lin’s unrealized profit reached 28,000. He started fantasizing about renovating a new home, imagining the moment he’d show off his house keys in his朋友圈. He didn’t take profit—instead, he felt it could go up even more.

But the market never pities the greedy.

At 2:00 a.m., a massive bearish candle crashed down. CELO plunged from 0.119 straight to 0.095. Xiao Lin’s position began to be in trouble; his margin ratio kept dropping. He frantically tried to add margin, but the money in his bank card had long since been transferred entirely into his futures account.

“Don’t keep dropping… please, don’t drop anymore.” He prayed at the screen, his voice trembling.

At 3:17 a.m., the liquidation notice popped up. The system automatically liquidated all his positions. His 100,000 yuan principal went to zero.

Xiao Lin sat motionless in front of the computer in his rental room. Outside the window, the city was lit up with thousands of lights. He thought about his mother’s phone call saying, “Save up enough and come back.” He thought about his girlfriend saying, “I don’t care whether there’s a house.” And yet, for a nebulous number, he had bet everything.

He turned off his phone, and for the first time, he felt how cold the city’s night was.

The next morning, CELO rebounded to 0.116. If he had taken profit yesterday, he could have made 20,000 more. But the market never has “what if.”

Later, Xiao Lin posted this experience in Binance Plaza. In the comments, some people said, “I lost like that too.” Others said, “Take care, brother.” He read them one by one and suddenly realized that on this road, there were so many people just like him.

He deleted his futures account and found a new job. Occasionally he still checks the market, but he never opened a futures position again.

Some lessons are enough after just once.

content:
那个夜晚，我永远无法忘记

凌晨三点十七分，手机屏幕的蓝光照在小林脸上。他盯着K线图，眼睛布满血丝，已经整整六个小时没有合眼。

三个月前，小林还是个安分守己的程序员，月薪两万，攒了十万块准备付首付。一切改变发生在那个周五的晚上，他在币安广场看到一个帖子，有人说自己用合约一个月赚了八十万。

"十万变八十万，只需要二十倍杠杆。"这个数字像毒药一样钻进小林的脑子。

他先开了五千块的仓位，二十倍做多CELO。那天CELO从0.089涨到0.11，他赚了三千块。三千块，他上了一天班都赚不到这么多。那一刻，他觉得找到了人生的捷径。

然后是加仓。一万，三万，五万，最后他把所有积蓄十万块全部压了进去。二十倍杠杆，做多CELO。他给自己设了个目标，涨到0.15就收手，能赚六万六。

"等我赚够首付，就收手。"他这样告诉自己。

CELO确实涨到了0.119，小林的浮盈到了两万八。他开始幻想新房的装修，幻想在朋友圈晒钥匙的样子。他没有止盈，反而觉得还能再涨。

然而市场从不怜悯贪婪的人。

凌晨两点，一根巨大的阴线砸下来。CELO从0.119直接跌到0.095。小林的仓位开始告急，保证金率一路下滑。他疯狂地想补保证金，但银行卡里的钱早就全部转进了合约账户。

"不要跌了，求求你不要跌了。"他对着屏幕祈祷，声音发抖。

三点十七分，强平通知弹出。系统自动清算了他的全部仓位。十万块本金，归零。

小林呆坐在出租屋的电脑前，窗外是城市的万家灯火。他想起妈妈打电话来说"攒够钱就回来吧"，想起女朋友说"我不在乎有没有房子"。而他为了一个虚无缥缈的数字，把一切都赌了进去。

他关掉手机，第一次觉得这个城市的夜，这么冷。

第二天早上，CELO反弹到了0.116。如果他昨天止盈，还能赚两万。但市场没有如果。

后来小林把这段经历发在了币安广场，评论区里有人说"我也是这样亏的"，有人说"兄弟保重"。他一条一条地看，忽然发现，原来这条路上，有这么多和他一样的人。

他删掉了合约账户，重新找了一份工作。偶尔还是会看行情，但再也没有开过合约。

有些教训，一次就够了。

截至2026年9月29日，以太坊现货价格报2712美元，过去数小时内呈现温和上涨走势。从小时级别K线来看，ETH从2676美元附近起步，逐步攀升至2735美元高点，随后回落至2712美元一线震荡。价格运行在布林带中轨上方，上轨压力位约在2721美元附近，短期面临一定阻力。

均线系统方面，7周期均线已上穿25周期均线，形成短期多头排列。99周期均线位于2687美元位置，已被价格有效突破并站稳其上方，显示中长期趋势转好。EMA指标同样确认多头排列，7周期EMA为2702美元，25周期EMA为2687美元，99周期EMA为2684美元，三线呈多头发散形态。

MACD指标表现强势，快线8.48远高于慢线3.79，柱状图维持在4.69的正值区域。MACD柱状图已连续多个周期保持正值并持续扩张，表明多头动能充沛，买盘力量占据主导。

RSI指标方面，6周期RSI为67.46，12周期RSI为61.78，24周期RSI为56.82。各周期RSI均处于多头区域，但距离超买区域仍有距离，说明上涨动能尚未过度消耗。KDJ指标中K值为71.91，D值为64.95，J值为85.81，整体处于偏强区域但未进入极端超买。

布林带显示价格在中轨2686美元和上轨2721美元之间运行，带宽适中。ATR指标维持在19.6美元附近，波动率较低，暗示市场处于蓄势阶段。威廉指标为负27.75，处于偏强区域。随机RSI指标达到92.90，已进入超买区域，短期可能出现小幅回调。

从综合信号来看，15个因子中8个发出做多信号，6个发出做空信号，做多比例53.33%。综合指标给出做空信号，但整体胜率高达71.79%，空头信号的历史胜率较高，需保持警惕。

以太坊当前市场情绪偏向积极。从基本面来看，机构持续增持是推动ETH价格的重要力量。现货ETF持续获得资金流入，企业层面的增持也在加速，部分机构已持有接近总供应量4.9%的ETH，供应端的持续收缩为价格上行提供了坚实基础。

translatedData.content:
📰 Just said that an Ethereum upgrade is coming, but suddenly the time changed—why isn’t this tweak as important to ETH as people might think?

Just a couple of days ago, Ethereum was said to be preparing for an upgrade, and the open interest on Hyperliquid even hit a peak. Then a CoinTelegraph report said Ethereum moved the GlAmsterdam upgrade date earlier—from September to October 6—and this time it’s only happening on a testnet, Sepolia. In short: the upgrade contents stay the same, but it’s been pushed to the testnet stage; the mainnet rollout date is still not set.

First, testnet upgrades are a normal part of the process. The ETH team has recently been busy with another major upgrade, and moving GlAmsterdam to mainnet has to wait until that work is done. Also, this change is only about the testnet schedule; the mainnet launch isn’t changed, which indicates things are on track. More importantly, the GlAmsterdam upgrade is actually quite substantial this time: it separates the proposer-builder roles, introduces a block-level access list, and brings a new gas pricing mechanism. Basically, these new features are beneficial for ETH’s long-term ecosystem development—people just need to wait and see since the testnet upgrade was moved up.

Impact on the market
This testnet upgrade’s impact on ETH is more of a psychological one. ETH has been rising too fast, and many longs are worried about a pullback. Seeing the upgrade delayed may lead some to pause and observe for now. But in the long run, these new features will make ETH more secure and more scalable—for example, the new gas pricing mechanism can reduce costs for small users. And once the Sepolia testnet code runs successfully, the eventual mainnet launch becomes even more something to look forward to.

💡 The ETH testnet upgrade is a good thing, but in the short term it may cap some upward momentum. If $2,700 holds, then we’ll see whether the test results go smoothly; if a serious issue forces the mainnet launch to be delayed, then this view is no longer valid.

title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines Ethereum’s Broader Role in the Digital Economy by 2030
subTitle:
Ethereum could be headed toward a model in which the network processes substantially more activity without requiring every participating computer to perform every calculation itself, according to a vision outlined by co-founder Vitalik Buterin.
The shift would represent a significant change in how the blockchain’s work is distributed. Ethereum has traditionally relied on many independent computers, known as nodes, to verify the same transactions and execute the same smart-contract code. That repetition is central to the network’s security: participants do not need to trust a single operator because they can check the results for themselves. It also creates a practical limit. As activity increases, the amount of data and computation that each node must handle can become a barrier to wider participation.
Buterin’s longer-term outlook, extending toward 2030, focuses on moving beyond that constraint without abandoning Ethereum’s decentralized character. Rather than asking every computer to repeat the full workload, the network could divide responsibilities among different layers and use cryptographic methods to confirm that more intensive processing was performed correctly.
The distinction is important. A blockchain is often described as a shared database, but it is also a system for reaching agreement on the results of computation. Every transaction changes the network’s state, whether by transferring funds, interacting with a decentralized application or triggering a smart contract. In Ethereum’s current design, validators and other network participants must process enough information to establish that those changes follow the rules. Increasing the number of transactions therefore tends to increase the burden on the machines that secure the system.
A future architecture could separate execution from verification more extensively. Specialized systems might handle large volumes of transactions, while Ethereum itself would retain the role of settling disputes, checking proofs and preserving a common record. The chain would still provide the final source of authority, but not every node would necessarily need to reproduce every intermediate step.
This approach builds on ideas that have shaped Ethereum’s scaling debate for years. Layer-2 networks, for example, conduct transactions outside the main chain and submit data or evidence back to Ethereum. Such systems are designed to reduce pressure on the base layer while relying on Ethereum for settlement and security. Other research areas, including zero-knowledge proofs and more efficient ways to access blockchain data, seek to allow one party to demonstrate that a computation was performed correctly without requiring everyone else to repeat it in full.
The central challenge is balancing efficiency with verification. If too much responsibility is placed in a small number of service providers, Ethereum could become faster while becoming more dependent on trusted intermediaries. That would weaken one of the features that distinguishes a public blockchain from a conventional database. Buterin’s vision therefore concerns not simply adding capacity, but finding ways to distribute the ability to verify the network’s activity as widely as possible.
For ordinary users, the consequences could include lower costs, quicker application performance and access to services that are currently difficult to operate at scale. Games, financial applications, social platforms and other software built on Ethereum could handle more activity if the underlying infrastructure no longer forced every node to carry the entire computational load. Developers could also gain more flexibility in designing applications that would be impractical under stricter processing limits.
The benefits would not arrive automatically. More complicated systems can introduce new technical risks, including errors in software, weaknesses in proof mechanisms and difficulties coordinating multiple layers. Data availability is another concern. Even when computation is performed away from the main chain, users and independent operators may still need access to enough information to verify results or reconstruct the state of an application. A design that reduces computational demands but makes essential data difficult to obtain could create a different form of centralization.
There is also a governance dimension. Ethereum’s rules are maintained through a broad ecosystem of developers, validators, users, companies and application operators. Any major change to the way computation is divided would require extensive testing and agreement across that community. The network’s history shows that technical improvements are often implemented incrementally, with competing proposals evaluated over time rather than adopted as a single package.
The 2030 horizon should therefore be understood as a direction for development rather than a guarantee that a particular final structure will be in place by that year. Blockchain engineering is shaped by research breakthroughs, security reviews, market demand and the performance of systems deployed along the way. Some concepts may be combined, revised or replaced before they become part of Ethereum’s permanent infrastructure.
What remains clear from Buterin’s vision is the attempt to resolve a foundational tension in decentralized networks. Ethereum wants to support far more activity, but it also wants independent participants to retain the ability to check what the system is doing. Its next phase may depend on separating the work of carrying out transactions from the work of proving that those transactions were carried out according to the rules. If that separation can be achieved without concentrating control, Ethereum would move beyond the traditional assumption that every computer in a blockchain must perform the same calculation.

$ETH surged $BTC on open interest on Hyperliquid, first time touching $3.02 billion

On Hyperliquid, the derivatives exchange is carrying about one-tenth of the total derivatives open interest of the entire crypto market—the bets behind $ETH  having just surpassed $BTC. The figure is $3.02 billion versus $2.8 billion, as of this morning.

Throughout 2026, these two coins have been trading places for the top spot, neck-and-neck to the point where who goes up or down only differs by a few hundred million dollars. This time, $ETH has clearly pulled ahead.

Open interest is the total value of outstanding derivatives contracts that have not yet been settled. It does not predict whether prices will rise or fall; it only shows which coin traders are putting more money into.

The actual prices this morning: $ETH around $2,717, up 2.48% on the day; $BTC around $84,200, up 1.62%. Both are rebounding after a streak of highly volatile sessions just past.

One thing worth watching: whether $ETH can hold this position over the next few days, or if it’s only a temporary deviation before $BTC regains the top spot.

Personal observation only, not investment advice.

Bitmine holdings discussion increases｜Asset valuation is not new cash flow｜Before confirming 2738, I’ll wait

My view is that I recognize the company’s disclosure of its holdings, but I don’t interpret an increase in asset size as directly meaning that capital is accelerating buying ETH. The number of discussions in the forum topic #BitMineETHHoldingsTop6Million increased from 186 in the previous round to 223, and the level of attention has indeed risen; however, the number of followers isn’t trading volume, and it’s not orders you can directly use to chase longs.

This time I’m looking at the valuation basis. Bitmine’s September 28 announcement and the attachment disclosed by the SEC on the same day both state: as of 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on September 27, it held 6,001,302 ETH, valued at $2,698 per coin. The total for crypto assets, cash and marketable securities, and other investments is about $17.2 billion. Of that, $672 million is the combined amount of cash and marketable securities—not all bank cash—and it is not defined in the announcement as the next ETH buy order. The fact is that holdings and valuation have been disclosed; how it will be allocated in the future still requires waiting for official information.

How does this affect trading? With the same quantity of ETH, a rise in coin price can raise the asset valuation. If we calculate using the disclosed holdings, for every $10 increase in ETH, with other conditions unchanged, the corresponding holdings valuation increases by about $60.01 million. This is only a sensitivity calculation, not actual new funds, not realized profit from selling. When you mix valuation increases, financing deposits, and spot accumulation into one signal, it’s easy to overestimate marginal buy orders. What I care more about is the next verifiable change in the number of ETH held, as well as the sources of funds and allocation plan.

At 18:28 Beijing time, Binance ETH/USDT is around 2714.22, with a rolling 24-hour rise of about 2.46%, ranging from 2648.04 to 2735. The market has already risen, but that doesn’t prove that the entire move is driven by Bitmine’s news. When price is near the upper end of the range, I require acceptance after a breakout, not using the company’s asset scale as a substitute for confirmation from the order book. If it pulls back and breaks below the lower end of the range, or if there is an official disclosure of selling/deleveraging, I will overturn my short-term bullish observation.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate. I would only consider conditional spot long entries, without leverage. Only if there is a one-hour close above 2738, and then a retest from 2730 to 2738 that holds without breaking, and the trading platform is operating normally, would I use up to 0.3% of total funds for a trial entry. If it’s not triggered, I keep a zero position. The target is to cut half at 2750 and fully close at 2770. After execution, if price falls to 2714, I stop out and close; or if two consecutive one-hour closes are below 2730, I exit as well. If price breaks below 2647 before entry, the plan is canceled. If there is a gap-up or slippage gets out of control, I won’t chase the price. This is a plan to be validated; it does not mean a trade has already been executed or that profit has already been made.

📰 U.S. Treasury yields hit a 24-year high—why is Bitcoin able to stop falling and bounce around 84K?

The yield on the 30-year U.S. Treasury note has surged to its highest level in 24 years, boosting risk-aversion sentiment in the market. After Bitcoin broke below 80K at the start of the week, it found support around 84K, and the price has recently rebounded clearly. Behind this phenomenon lies a complicated tug-of-war between expectations of further Fed rate hikes and global fund flows.

Why is this news important?
The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield is a bellwether for long-term interest rates. A sharp rise usually indicates that the Fed’s rate-hike cycle may be nearing its end, or that the market expects inflation to rebound significantly in the future. As a safe-haven asset, Bitcoin’s price is highly sensitive to this indicator. The rebound found support at 84K, which is exactly a key technical level—suggesting that bulls and bears have reached a temporary balance there. The deeper reason is that even as rate-hike expectations heat up, continued net inflows into Bitcoin ETFs still provide support, indicating that institutional capital has not fully exited.

Impact on the market
In the short term, if Bitcoin can hold above 84K, it may start a new round of rebound, with targets potentially looking toward 88K. If it breaks below 84K, investors should be wary of risk building up again. From the market structure, a high interest-rate environment suppresses growth-stock valuations, and some funds may rotate into Bitcoin in search of an alternative allocation. On the regulatory front, recent remarks from U.S. Treasury officials hinted that crypto regulation may be tightened, bringing uncertainty to the market. Historically, whenever U.S. long-term yields break through key psychological thresholds, Bitcoin often undergoes a period of testing support.

Trading ideas
💡 In this environment, if Bitcoin can stay above 84K, it suggests the balance between bulls and bears is leaning bullish. A key level to watch is 86K—if it can break above, the rebound strength could increase significantly. However, this view has invalidation conditions: if U.S. inflation data significantly exceeds expectations, leading the Fed to hike rates further, or if Bitcoin ETFs see outflows exceeding $2 billion, then this view would be invalid.

📰 Why Japan’s regulator is rolling out another stablecoin pilot? This time, it’s not digital—banks are stepping in together

Japan’s Financial Services Agency (FSA) announced that its Financial Technology Innovation Center will launch the fourth stablecoin trading and settlement pilot in September 2026. Participants include TradeWaltz, NTT DATA, and six major banks (Mizuho, MUFG, SMBC, and Mitsubishi UFJ Trust). This marks another step forward by Japan’s regulator on the path toward stablecoin compliance, and the banks’ involvement makes the practical use cases for this pilot even more worth期待.

Why is this news important?
As the world’s second-largest economy, Japan’s regulatory posture serves as a bellwether for the stablecoin industry. The most core change in this pilot is the shift in participants—from early fintech companies to a banking group. This suggests the regulator may already have confirmed the compliance value of stablecoins in certain trade scenarios, and is willing to see large financial institutions lead their application. Bank participation means stablecoins may no longer be only a digital asset, but could become part of the infrastructure for international trade settlement. Behind this is a deeper need to reduce cross-border payment costs and improve settlement efficiency.

For the market, Japan’s banks collectively entering a stablecoin pilot is like a reassurance to the global market: at least in one major economy, the integration of digital assets with the existing financial system is gaining regulatory approval. This contrasts with the U.S. SEC’s cautious stance on stablecoin ETFs and gives the market a different compliance-path option.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH prices, this is a sentiment positive. Even though the current BTC/ETH prices are still ranging between $84K and $2.7K, Japan’s regulator continuing its actions suggests a growing global consensus toward the infrastructure-ization of digital assets. That means that in the short term—even if the Fed continues tightening—there is another bullish reason: regulatory risk is decreasing. In the long run, bank involvement could drive stablecoin use cases from DeFi penetration into traditional trade, potentially opening new pathways for capital inflows into the crypto market.

Historically, similar events such as the Bank of Japan approving banks to issue CBDC in 2019 led to at least a 10%-15% short-term sentiment rebound. While it can’t be directly compared, compliance pilots led by banks tend to have more market pull than pure digital-asset pilots.

💡 If this Japan pilot succeeds, it could provide support for ETH in the $3K range by the end of 2026. But if an FTX-style trust crisis erupts in the U.S., causing global banks to reassess digital-asset risk, this thesis would be invalid. If the market can hold the psychological $2.5K level, then we’ll see whether bullish sentiment can turn into actual buy demand.

If Japan subsequently requires participating banks to post collateral or establishes a stricter clearing framework, this thesis would also be invalid.

📰 为何日本监管再推稳定币试点？这次不是数字，而是银行集体入场

日本金融厅宣布其金融科技创新中心将在2026年9月启动第四期稳定币交易结算试点，参与方包括TradeWaltz、NTT DATA以及六家大型银行（Mizuho、MUFG、SMBC、三菱UFJ信托）。这标志着日本监管层在稳定币合规化道路上又往前迈了一步，而银行们的参与让这次试点的实际应用场景更值得期待。

为什么这条新闻重要？
日本作为全球第二大经济体，其监管态度对稳定币行业具有风向标意义。此次试点最核心的变化在于参与主体的转变——从早期的Fintech公司转向银行集团。这意味着监管层可能已经确认了稳定币在某些贸易场景下的合规价值，并愿意看到大型金融机构主导其应用。银行参与意味着稳定币将不再仅仅是数字资产，而是可能成为国际贸易结算中的一部分基础设施，这背后是降低跨境支付成本、提高结算效率的深层需求。

对市场而言，日本银行集体入局稳定币试点，相当于给全球市场吃了一颗定心丸：至少在一个主要经济体，数字资产与现有金融体系的融合正在获得监管认可。这与美国SEC对稳定币ETF的审慎态度形成对比，为市场提供了不同的合规路径选择。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH价格而言，这是一个情绪上的利好。虽然目前BTC/ETH价格仍在$84K和$2.7K区间震荡，但日本监管层的持续动作暗示了全球对数字资产基础设施化的共识正在形成。这意味着短期内，即使美联储等继续紧缩，市场也多了一个看多理由——监管风险在降低。从长期看，银行入场将推动稳定币应用场景从DeFi渗透到传统贸易，这可能为加密市场带来新的资金流入路径。

历史上类似事件如2019年日本央行批准银行发行CBDC，都为市场带来了至少10%-15%的短期情绪反弹，虽然不能简单类比，但银行主导的合规试点往往比纯数字资产试点更具市场号召力。

💡 这次日本试点如果成功，可能会在2026年底推动ETH在$3K区间获得支撑。但如果FTX-style的信任危机在美国爆发，导致全球银行对数字资产风险重新评估，这个判断作废。守住$2.5K这个心理关口，则看多情绪能否转化为实际买盘。

如果日本后续要求参与银行缴纳保证金或设立更严格的清算框架，这个判断作废。

In its latest report, BlackRock predicts that stablecoins will soon become the payment backbone in the autonomous AI era. This doesn’t mean crypto will replace fiat money; rather, AI needs a settlement method that is faster and cheaper than traditional systems. For the entire digital commerce ecosystem—especially the stablecoin market—this implies huge room for imagination.

Why is this news important?
The key to this prediction is BlackRock’s authority. As the world’s largest asset manager, the directions they focus on often trigger ripple effects across the market. The core logic is this: the AI economy requires instant settlement. Compared with today’s bank transfers that can take days, and credit card fees that are costly, stablecoins offer an alternative that could enable near-instant settlement—potentially within seconds—with almost zero cost. That means every time AI completes an online transaction (for example, an autonomous vehicle paying a toll), stablecoins could be the intermediary.

Market impact
In the short term, the most direct impact of this news is positive for the stablecoin sector—such as regulated products like USDC and USDT. In the long term, if the AI economy’s scale truly becomes as large as the prediction suggests, demand for stablecoins could break through the limits of existing payment systems. The effects on BTC and ETH are more complicated. As a store of value, BTC could benefit if an AI payment network needs a base layer blockchain. Meanwhile, ETH—due to its smart contract capabilities—could become the operating system within the AI economy. Specifically on price, for BTC to hold the key level of $84,298, it needs confirmation that the AI economy is indeed growing rapidly; otherwise, funds will likely keep flowing into more clearly short-term stablecoin opportunities.

Trading idea
💡 I believe the stablecoin sector may outperform the broader market in the short term, but the $84,298 BTC level still requires caution. If, in the coming month, major technical bottlenecks emerge in the AI space (such as excessively high compute costs), this view would become invalid.

📰 Bitcoin open-interest interest just fell after saying it dropped—what does the new low in futures scale actually mean?

A few days ago, it was said that when Bitcoin’s futures open interest declined, it could still rise by 35%. Now this interest has fallen to a two-year low again. Put simply, it means futures participants are putting in less money and fewer bets. This can trigger a chain reaction in global crypto trading volume and capital flows—especially in places like South Korea, where the futures market is particularly active.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that the futures market is where institutional funds and speculators concentrate. If everyone stops playing futures, it suggests:
1. Institutions may think Bitcoin risk is higher and start allocating via other methods
2. Short-term speculative demand is drying up, and market sentiment turns cautious
3. Futures trading fees are high and settlement is troublesome, so people switch directly to the spot market

And based on its connection to recent other events—this is quite different from the contrast seen with US PPI cooling down, while the bond market remains wildly active. In other words: money hasn’t disappeared; it just doesn’t want to put everything into Bitcoin futures anymore.

Market impact
The impact on BTC/ETH prices should be:
- Short-term sentiment: slightly bearish, because futures typically react before spot
- But for the medium term, if ETF inflows continue, spot demand may still provide support

South Korea is one of the most active crypto trading markets globally. Local capital moving out of futures → could mean increased future sell pressure on BTC at Korean exchanges, or a rotation into other coins such as ETH. A historical reference for similar events is the kind of collapse in futures positions during the 2008 financial crisis.

Trading approach
💡 Neutral to slightly bearish. The key price range to watch is $80K–$81K. If ETF capital inflows suddenly surge, this view is invalid.

🤔 BNB Chain adds 9.85 million stablecoin holders in a week—why does it crush other networks?

In a single week, BNB Chain added 985,000 stablecoin holders. This figure leaves every other public blockchain in the dust. Although its total stablecoin value still can’t match that of established legacy chains, the speed of user growth is truly astonishing. For the crypto industry, this suggests BNB Chain may have found a breakthrough in the race to capture the digital asset storage market.

Why is this news important?
This data means BNB Chain is competing for the “digital dollar” storage market at a faster pace than even popular chains like Ethereum and Solana combined. The core reason is BNB Chain’s “two-way exchange” strategy—users can earn yield on-chain with BNB, and they can also swap USDT/USDC for the chain’s native token BNB, then swap back. This model lowers the barrier for stablecoin usage for ordinary users far more than on other chains. Behind it is the traffic-siphoning effect of the Binance ecosystem: exchange users can seamlessly move their stored assets to BNB Chain.

Impact on the market
For BTC, this news will likely boost crypto market sentiment in the short term, because BNB Chain’s strong growth signals continued recognition of public chain storage value. But in the long run, if BNB Chain can sustain this user growth rate, it may divert some funds that would otherwise flow into L2 networks or traditional exchanges. The impact on ETH is more subtle—while Ethereum’s Layer2 ecosystem is powerful, the stablecoin user growth model is different. That means competition between the two chains has entered a new battleground: the “storage market.” A historical reference would be Solana’s DeFi boom in Q1 2024, but that was explosive growth—this time it’s steady and sustainable.

Trading idea
💡 I tend to believe BNB Chain’s stablecoin user growth is a signal of the shift of the crypto storage market toward public chains. If this trend continues, it may provide short-term support to ETH’s price around $2,700. However, note that this view would be invalidated if BNB Chain announces large-scale locking of stablecoins to preserve value.

If, over the next two weeks, the number of new users on BNB Chain slows to below 2 million, this view would also be invalidated.

BNB Chain在单周内新增985,000个稳定币持有人，这个数字把其他所有公链都甩在身后。虽然总稳定币价值上它还比不上老牌公链，但用户增长速度实在惊人。对加密货币行业来说，这意味着BNB Chain可能在争夺数字资产存储市场方面找到了突破口。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这个数据意味着BNB Chain在争夺"数字美元"存储市场的速度，比以太坊、Solana这些热门公链加起来还要快。根本原因在于BNB Chain的"双向兑换"策略——用户既能用BNB在链上赚收益，也能把USDT/USDC换成链上原生代币BNB，再兑换回来。这种模式让稳定币对普通用户来说，门槛比其他公链低得多。这背后是Binance生态的流量虹吸效应在起作用，交易所用户可以无缝迁移到BNB Chain存储资产。

对市场的影响
对BTC来说，这个新闻短期内会提振加密市场情绪，因为BNB Chain的强增长证明了公链存储价值的持续认可。但长期看，如果BNB Chain能维持这个用户增速，可能会分流一部分本来会流入L2网络或传统交易所的钱。对ETH的影响则更微妙——ETH的Layer2生态虽然强大，但稳定币用户增长模式不同，这意味着两个公链的竞争进入了"存储市场"这个新战场。历史参考可以看Solana2024年Q1的DeFi爆火，但那次是爆发式增长，这次是持续稳健的增长。

操作思路
💡 我倾向于认为BNB Chain的稳定币用户增长是加密存储市场向公链转移的信号。这个趋势如果持续，短期内可能推动ETH价格在$2,700附近获得支撑，但要注意如果BNB Chain宣布大规模上锁稳定币以保价值，这个判断作废。

如果未来两周BNB Chain新增用户数放缓到200万以下，这个判断作废。
