I used to think I understood the market well—until it woke me up by making me lose money
When I first entered the crypto space, my biggest problem was being too confident. #ETH 

After getting a few predictions right, I thought I had found a method. Back then, I studied charts every day, watching price movements, and I practically wanted to join every fluctuation.

Later, for a period of time, I made quite a bit in a row.
When the account is up, people get easy to get carried away. At that time, I started to believe there were more and more opportunities, and my positions became bolder and bolder. When I saw a coin spike quickly, I didn’t wait for my trading conditions to be met—I just rushed in.

Then the market suddenly corrected.
At first, I still thought it was fine, because I had profited before, so I felt confident. But when the losses expanded, that’s when I realized: past profits can’t protect you from current mistakes.

After that, I reorganized my trading habits.
First, don’t go in with your full position, and don’t all-in. The market always has surprises. Leaving some room gives me opportunities.

Second, think about risk before opening a trade. Don’t just think about how much you want to make—also consider the maximum loss you can tolerate.

Third, don’t trade against the trend. If the market doesn’t move in your expected direction, don’t force it.

Fourth, accumulate on dips with patience. A “cheap” price isn’t necessarily a good opportunity.

Fifth, don’t chase market hype. When everyone is疯狂, you need to stay calm even more.

Sixth, after a streak of consecutive wins, reduce position size. When you’re making money, it’s easiest to lose respect and caution.

Seventh, after losses, don’t rush to get it back. Emotional trading often leads to even bigger losses.

Eighth, pay attention to changes in volume and price. Whether the price increase has real capital support is extremely important.

Ninth, wait for your own opportunity. Trading every day isn’t the same thing as “working hard.”

The longer I trade, the more I realize one truth:
The market never lacks opportunities—what it lacks are disciplined people.
In the past, I wanted to catch every rise. Now I only want to do my own trades well.

Because trading isn’t a sprint—it’s a long-term survival game. If you want this market to support your life, the most important thing isn’t making money the fastest, but being able to keep going steadily. #BTC  #币圈生存法则  #BeginnerMustRead

我曾经以为自己很懂行情，直到市场让我亏醒
刚进入币圈的时候，我最大的毛病就是太自信。#ETH 

看到几次行情判断对了，就觉得自己找到了方法。那时候每天研究走势，盯着价格变化，恨不得每一次波动都参与。

后来有一段时间，我连续赚了不少。
账户上涨的时候，人很容易飘。那时候我开始觉得机会越来越多，仓位也越来越大胆。看到一个币快速上涨，没有等自己的交易条件出现，就直接冲进去。

结果行情突然调整。
最开始我还觉得没事，因为之前赚过，所以心里有底。后来亏损扩大，我才发现，过去的盈利并不能保护现在的错误。

那次之后，我重新整理自己的交易习惯。
第一，不满仓，不梭哈。市场永远有意外，留一点空间，就是给自己留机会。

第二，开仓之前先想风险。不要只想着赚多少，也要想最多能接受亏多少。

第三，不逆势交易。市场没有按照你的方向走，就不要硬撑。

第四，低吸需要耐心。便宜的价格，不一定就是好的机会。

第五，不追市场热度。所有人都疯狂的时候，更需要保持冷静。

第六，连续盈利以后降低仓位。赚钱的时候，最容易失去敬畏。

第七，亏损以后不要急着翻本。情绪交易，往往会带来更大的亏损。

第八，关注量价变化。价格上涨有没有真实资金支持，非常重要。

第九，等待属于自己的机会。不是每天交易，才叫努力。

做交易时间越久，我越发现一个道理：
市场从来不缺机会，缺的是有纪律的人。
以前我想抓住每一次上涨，现在我只想做好属于自己的交易。

因为交易不是短跑，是一场长期生存。
想靠这个市场养家，最重要的不是赚得最快，而是能够稳定走下去。#BTC

一、以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格，多空力量趋于均衡

二〇二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千六百九十二美元，过去数小时在二千六百七十七美元至二千七百美元之间波动。与比特币类似，以太坊在经历了前期的上涨后进入调整阶段，但Glamsterdam升级预期和机构持续增持为价格提供了有力支撑。

A Federal Reserve Board Member Discusses AI Agent Payments｜Lower Fees and Authorization Matter More Than “Which Chain to Choose”｜Before ETH Breaks Above 2720, I’ll Wait

My stance is to observe: I don’t read industry discussions from a central bank official as an official endorsement of Ethereum. In remarks on September 29 about “Payments in the Era of AI Agents,” Federal Reserve Governor Waller did, in fact, mention that stablecoins can improve the potential for cross-border payments. He also said that when AI agents make small payments for things like data and API calls, a payment rail with fixed fees and lower costs is often more suitable. But throughout the speech, he did not specify Ethereum as the settlement network, nor did he announce that the Federal Reserve would purchase ETH, approve a particular public chain, or provide a set of regulatory rules slated to be implemented. Jumping straight from “agents will make payments” to “ETH demand will inevitably surge” skips the real hard parts in between—merchant acceptance, user authorization, anti-fraud measures, clearing routes, and costs.

Waller divides agent business models into two types: assistance and delegation. In the former, humans decide and pay; in the latter, under constraints, the agent handles shopping and payments on their behalf. The delegation model requires stricter trust and guardrails. He specifically raised certification, responsibility allocation, and fraud risk, and noted that cross-border routing would weigh fees, speed, and reliability at the same time. For the crypto market, the opportunity isn’t just issuing an “AI payment coin,” but enabling authorization to be scoped, budgeted, and recorded—so small transactions aren’t swallowed by fees. The Ethereum.org payment documentation also lists stablecoin small-payment scenarios on low-cost Layer 2 networks, indicating there are feasible technical paths. But examples on a website don’t mean real merchant orders have already been scaled, nor does it mean every stablecoin transaction must translate into an equivalent ETH spot buy order.

What I care about most are three choke points for value transfer. First, whether the actual payment route is a bank card, bank instant payment, a private ledger, or an open chain—this speech didn’t pick a winner for the market. Second, even if the route is Ethereum Layer 2, users are paying with stablecoins; ETH may only benefit indirectly through fees, ordering, and settlement—both the amounts and timing still need verification. Third, after an agent receives authorization, if something goes wrong, who can revoke it, enforce limits, and assign accountability often matters more for institutional adoption than raw transactions per second. If later there are official merchant transaction volumes, on-chain fees, and data on funds flowing back to the mainnet, then we can reassess value capture. Don’t chase based on a talk’s headline alone.

Regarding market reaction, I found Binance’s ETH/USDT price at about $2689.61, with the past 24 hours ranging from a high of $2748.60 to a low of $2652.20, up roughly 0.11%. At the moment, there isn’t enough evidence to attribute this price movement to Waller’s speech. Around $2720 is my threshold for observing a short-term repair. If it repeatedly fails to break through, I’ll keep viewing the trend as a rebound within a range. If $2652 breaks and can’t be quickly reclaimed, cautious conditions for longs would be invalidated. If later facts show mainstream agent payments fully bypass the open chain, then my assessment of the mechanisms by which Ethereum benefits should be downgraded.

If this were my own trading plan: I’m not participating now—only considering unleveraged spot long positions. I’d wait for a one-hour close above $2720, then for the next hour to retest $2710 to $2720 without breaking, before deploying 2% of total funds. First target: $2748. Once reached, I’d cut half; the remainder would be watched toward $2790. Initial stop-loss: $2680. If price first drops below $2652, I’d cancel the entry plan. After entry, if two consecutive hourly candles close back below $2710, or if there are abnormal exchange deposits/withdrawals, or if official regulatory documents contradict the direction implied by the speech, I’d close the position—no waiting for targets. If conditions aren’t triggered, it stays a cash-only (no position) plan. I will not turn a scenario into actual filled trades.

Source: Waller’s September 29 official remarks; ethereum.org payment documentation; price: Binance ETH/USDT public quotes. #ETH

The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

美联储理事谈AI代理支付｜低费率与授权比“选哪条链”更关键｜ETH在2720前我先等

我的态度是观察，不把央行理事的行业讨论读成以太坊获官方背书。美联储理事沃勒在9月29日关于“AI代理时代的支付”的讲话中，确实提到稳定币可改善跨境支付的潜力，也谈到AI代理为数据、接口调用等进行小额付款时，更适合固定费用较低的支付轨道。但整篇讲话没有指定以太坊作为结算网络，更没有宣布美联储采购ETH、批准某条公链，或给出一份即将落地的监管规则。把“代理会付款”直接跳成“ETH需求必然爆发”，中间省掉了商户接受、用户授权、反欺诈、清算路线与成本这些真正难的环节。

沃勒把代理商业分成辅助与委托两种模式：前者由人决定并付款，后者在约束条件下让代理代为购物与支付；委托模式需要更严的信任与护栏。他特别提出认证、责任归属和欺诈风险，并指出跨境路由会同时权衡费用、速度和可靠性。对加密市场而言，机会不只是发行一个“AI支付币”，而是让授权有范围、有预算、有记录，并让小额交易不被手续费吞掉。以太坊官网支付说明也列出低成本二层网络上的稳定币小额支付场景，说明技术上存在可行路径；但官网举例不等于真实商户订单已经规模化，更不等于每笔稳定币交易都必须在ETH现货形成等额买盘。

我更关心收益传导的三个关口。第一，实际付款走银行卡、银行即时支付、私有账本还是开放链，讲话并未替市场选定。第二，即便选择以太坊二层，用户付的是稳定币，ETH可能只通过手续费、排序和结算间接受益，金额与时滞都要核实。第三，代理获得授权后若出错，谁能撤销、限额、追责，往往比每秒处理量更影响机构采用。若今后有正式商户交易量、链上费用和回流主网的数据，再评估价值捕获；仅凭演讲标题不追涨。

市场反应方面，我查到币安ETH/USDT约2689.61美元，滚动24小时高2748.60、低2652.20，涨幅约0.11%。目前没有足够证据把这段价格变化归因于沃勒讲话。2720美元附近是我观察短线修复的门槛；如果反复冲不过去，仍把走势看成区间内反弹。2652附近若失守且无法快速收回，偏谨慎的条件多头假设被推翻；如果后续事实证明主流代理支付完全绕开开放链，以太坊受益的机制判断也需下调。

如果是我自己交易：现在不参与，只考虑无杠杆现货多单。要等一小时收盘站上2720美元，下一小时回踩2710至2720不破，才投入总资金的2%；第一目标2748美元，达到后减仓一半，剩余看2790美元。初始止损设在2680美元；若先跌破2652美元，取消入场计划。入场后若连续两根小时线收回2710下方，或出现交易所充提异常、监管正式文件与讲话方向相反，就平仓，不等目标。条件未触发就是空仓，绝不把设想写成实际成交。

来源：美联储沃勒9月29日正式讲话、ethereum.org支付说明；价格：币安ETH/USDT公开行情。#ETH

以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Imperium, a DeFi subsidiary under BTCS, recently stated that they have completed compliance preparations for an application to the SEC for a “regulated entity exemption.” Although they have already filed the necessary notices and published the relevant disclosures, Imperium has not yet started offering stock-related token liquidity services. This is because, to provide such services, a qualified Tokenized Securities Venue (a tokenized securities trading venue) must first be up and running.

Why is this news important?
Imperium’s compliance move shows BTCS’s ambition in the tokenized securities market—but more importantly, it exposes a contradiction in market development: preparations for regulatory compliance are accelerating, but the actual market infrastructure is not yet ready. BTCS’s behavior is more like a strategic contingency plan in case the tokenized securities market suddenly gains traction. Why does that matter? Because it means regulatory and market timelines are not aligned—regulators (the SEC) are drafting the rules, while market participants begin preparing themselves before the rules are clearly defined.

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTCS’s compliance preparations may boost market sentiment, since more compliant participants generally mean greater transparency. But the long-term impact depends on when the tokenized securities market actually launches. If it keeps getting delayed, then BTCS’s preparations may end up as just costs. It’s like automakers developing electric-vehicle charging stations in advance—if the charging network still can’t roll out, the automakers’ efforts may be wasted. 1.8 billion USD liquidated in a day. $BTC  and $ETH  are both involved; the culprit isn’t bad news.

That’s a chain-liquidation event. Many people join the long side with high leverage—when the price retreats only slightly, the weakest leveraged positions hit the bottom.

The exchange automatically triggers the liquidation orders. Closing orders add more sell pressure, pushing the price down further and triggering the next round of margin calls. No one has to actually sell—if the server does its job, that’s enough.

On 23/09, derivatives recorded about 1.8 billion USD worth of liquidations within 24 hours, according to FXStreet. The Block calls this the strongest altcoin liquidation event since 2021.

Before that, the funding rate had been positive for many days—a sign that the long side was paying to keep positions open, with the crowd clearly skewed to one side. The more lopsided it is, the cleaner the collapse.

What proves I’m wrong: if the funding rate has already returned close to 0 but the price still doesn’t bounce, then this is no longer just excessive leverage. At that point, real money is withdrawing—this is a demand issue, not a technical problem caused by leverage.

Key marker to watch: how quickly the total open interest across the whole market replenishes after the sell-off. Fast reloading means nothing has been learned yet; slow reloading is a more stable temporary bottom.

This mechanism doesn’t distinguish between big coins and small coins, or between good news and bad news. It only needs a sufficiently large crowd betting on the same direction with high enough leverage.

Brothers and friends, ask yourselves again: are you opening your position because you believe in the trend, or because you’re afraid of missing out when you see others just profiting?

Personal observation, not investment advice

1,8 tỷ đô thanh lý một ngày. $BTC và $ETH đều dính, thủ phạm không phải tin xấu.

Đó là chuỗi thanh lý dây chuyền. Đông người cùng mở long với đòn bẩy cao, giá chỉ lùi nhẹ là ký quỹ lô yếu nhất chạm đáy.

Sàn tự đóng lệnh đó. Lệnh đóng tạo thêm áp lực bán, đẩy giá lùi tiếp, chạm ký quỹ lô kế tiếp. Không cần ai bán thật, chỉ cần máy chủ làm đúng việc.

Hôm 23/09, phái sinh ghi nhận khoảng 1,8 tỷ đô thanh lý trong 24 giờ, theo FXStreet. The Block gọi đây là đợt thanh lý altcoin mạnh nhất kể từ 2021.

Trước đó, phí tài trợ (funding rate) đã dương cao nhiều ngày — dấu hiệu bên long đang trả tiền để giữ lệnh, đám đông lệch hẳn một phía. Càng lệch, cú sập càng gọn.

Điều gì chứng minh mình sai: nếu phí tài trợ đã về gần 0 mà giá vẫn không hồi, thì đây không còn là chuyện đòn bẩy quá tay. Lúc đó dòng tiền thật đang rút, một vấn đề về nhu cầu, không phải trục trặc kỹ thuật của đòn bẩy.

Mốc đáng theo dõi: khối lượng hợp đồng mở toàn thị trường có chất lại nhanh sau cú xả không. Chất nhanh là chưa học được gì, chất chậm mới là đáy tạm ổn định hơn.

Cơ chế này không phân biệt coin lớn nhỏ, không phân biệt tin tốt xấu. Nó chỉ cần một đám đông đủ đông cùng đặt cược một hướng với đòn bẩy đủ cao.

二〇二六年九月二十九日，以太坊现货价格报二千六百九十五美元，过去数小时在二千六百七十至二千七百美元区间内窄幅整理。ETH在经历前期调整后，目前在二千七百美元下方形成了相对稳定的支撑区域，市场等待即将到来的Glamsterdam升级作为新的催化剂。

二、技术指标全面解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百九十二点六七美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百九十一点八三美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百八十七点五四美元。三条均线高度粘合，差距不足五美元，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键时刻。价格目前略高于所有主要均线，短期多头略占优势，但优势并不明显。

MACD指标方面，快线报二点五三，慢线报五点七七，柱状图为负三点二四。MACD快线虽处于零轴上方，但已低于慢线形成死叉，柱状图为负值且持续扩大，显示短期动能偏弱。不过快线绝对值仍为正值，表明中期趋势尚未完全转空。

In the crypto market, I often call myself a “fool.”
#ETH 
With small capital, I’ve multiplied it several times—never liquidated, never chasing the hottest trends, and even too lazy to stare at the candlestick chart repeatedly. People around me say I’m lucky. But they don’t understand: “being a fool” is the most reliable moat in this market.

There are too many smart people. They rotate positions every three minutes, the moment a good-catalyst signal appears they all rush in. In futures, they max the leverage to bet on direction. After only a slight pullback, the account goes straight to zero.

They’re not that they don’t understand technical analysis—quite the opposite: they understand too much. They move too fast, and their greed is too great. They always want to eat everything in one bite.

I’m the opposite.
A few steps: start with a tiny position to probe the market first, and only trade opportunities where the uptrend is just beginning and the certainty is high.

I don’t touch trash coins, and I don’t bother with half-hearted excitement from the news. Place a small base position, then wait slowly.

If you can’t hold on, you don’t have the right to make money. When the market finally calms down and the price action is completely confirmed, then take a portion of your funds to follow in. Let the main force buy at the bottom—I only take the most stable segment.

After one cycle of the market, I withdraw my funds. I don’t dream about consecutive green days, and I don’t “fall in love” with any coin. To me, the crypto market is a cash machine: take the money, turn around, and leave.

This strategy isn’t glamorous at all, but it works—plain and simple.
A while back, a brother of mine lost money until he was close to breaking down. He said he never wants to play smart tricks again. He followed this method for a while—he not only got back to even, but also earned enough to buy a new car.

Another fan started with a small amount of capital. By relying on patience and splitting entries, he managed to grow it into a solid number. He said if he had known, he wouldn’t have messed around so carelessly back then.

The crypto market has never been a game for trading brilliance—it’s a hellscape of emotion control and position management. If you lose money, it’s never because you can’t read candlesticks. It’s because your heart is too impatient, your position is too big, and your head is too stubborn.

After reading this, you have two paths: keep losing money over and over by relying on tricks, or “play dumb” like I do—put the steady money into your pocket.

币圈里，我常说自己是个“傻子”。
#ETH 
小资金翻了好几倍，从没爆过仓，从不追热点，连K线都懒得反复盯。身边人都说我运气好，其实他们不懂：“傻”，才是这个市场最稳的护城河。

聪明人太多了。三分钟换一次仓，利好刚冒头就一窝蜂冲进去，合约拉满赌方向。一个小幅回踩，账户直接归零。

他们不是不懂技术，恰恰是懂太多：手太快、心太贪，总想一口吃成胖子。

我刚好反过来。
办法就几步：极小仓位先探路，只做趋势刚冒头、确定性高的机会。

垃圾币不碰，消息面的热闹半分不凑。丢个底仓进去，然后慢慢等。

熬不住的人，根本没资格赚钱。等市场彻底躁动、走势完全确认，再拿一部分资金跟进。底部让主力去抄，我只吃最稳的那一段。

一轮行情走完就出金。不做连涨的美梦，也不跟任何币种“谈恋爱”。币圈对我来说就是提款机，取完钱转身就走。

这套打法一点都不帅，但实打实管用。
之前有个兄弟亏到快崩溃，说再也不想耍小聪明了。跟着这套方法走了一段时间，不仅回了本，还赚够钱换了新车。

还有个粉丝拿小资金起步，靠耐心和分仓，硬生生滚到了不错的数字。他说早知道当初就不瞎折腾了。

币圈从来不是拼技术的赛场，是拼情绪管控和仓位管理的修罗场。你亏钱，从来不是输在不会看K线，是输在心太急、仓太满、头太铁。

看完这篇，你有两条路：继续靠小聪明反复亏钱，或者跟我一样“装傻”，把稳稳的钱揣进兜里。

SEC tokenized-stock exemption brought up again | Permissioned trading doesn’t specify Ethereum | Before ETH confirms at 2710, I’ll wait

My stance is still cautious—I won’t directly translate the policy space for “stock tokenization” into spot ETH buy pressure. On Binance Square today, the trending topics are earnings reports, NEAR spot ETFs, and U.S. job openings; none of them are the correct topic tags for this rule, so I won’t borrow tags for this post. When Binance News again mentions the SEC chair supporting on-chain securities, I go back to the original SEC document to verify: the September 17 commission release is a temporary, condition-attached “innovative exemption.” It allows tokenized security trading venues that meet the criteria, within a permissioned environment, to trade a portion of tokenized U.S.-listed stocks using automated market making and liquidity-pool trades, and provides corresponding exemptions for specified liquidity providers. It is not a brand-new law passed today, and it does not designate Ethereum as the only settlement chain.

The key limitations matter more than slogans. The SEC chair’s explanation states that venues must comply with sanctions requirements; participants are subject to permissioned access; the relevant stock tokens must retain the traditional stock’s dividends and voting rights; and issuers can also oppose the trading. Anti-fraud and anti-manipulation rules continue to apply. This kind of regulatory experiment may increase demand for on-chain clearing, custody, identity verification, and compliance tooling—but ultimately which chain to deploy on, whether to use a public chain, and whether trading volume is sufficient to create ETH fuel fees and burn, all depend on the venue’s and issuer’s formal choices. If trading is concentrated on permissioned chains or other networks, the transmission effect to ETH spot would be weak. Calling this “an approved trial” and claiming “Wall Street is already buying massive amounts of ETH” skips the most important evidence in between.

Market reactions also can’t be treated backward as cause and effect. This morning Beijing time, Binance ETHUSDT is around $2691, up about 0.68% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $2652 to $2749. This quote only shows price action is still within the range; it cannot prove that the move higher was driven by the September 17 filing. Farside’s September 29 Ethereum ETF page still shows dashes across each fund; the automatically displayed total of zero cannot be treated as final “zero net inflow.” And the recent full September 28 total of about $17.1 million net inflow also can’t be extrapolated to mean today’s money continues to pour in.

If I were trading it myself, I wouldn’t chase price. My direction would be preset: a small, unleveraged spot long position. Only if an ETH hourly close is above $2710, then pulls back to $2700–$2710 without breaking, and after seeing fund data update there isn’t clear weakening—then I’d consider a tentative position up to at most 0.3% of total funds. First target: $2748 to cut the position in half. Second target: $2780 to exit fully. If after entry it breaks below $2675, I’d execute a hard stop loss; or if two consecutive hours close below $2700, I’d close early. If before any trigger it drops below $2652, the entire long plan is canceled. Even if price breaks higher, if subsequent venue announcements make it clear they won’t use Ethereum, or if on-chain actual fees and usage don’t catch up for a long time, I would overturn the “ETH benefits” inference and won’t add to the position to bet on the narrative. What’s written here is a conditional plan—not a deal already made or money already earned.

Source check: SEC September 17 announcement and chair’s statement; Farside Ethereum ETF item-by-item table; Binance ETHUSDT rolling 24-hour行情.
#ETH
The above is for personal market observation only and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度仍是谨慎，不把“股票上链”的政策空间直接换算成ETH买盘。币安广场今天的热门话题集中在财报、NEAR现货ETF和美国职位空缺；它们都不是这项规则的准确话题标签，所以这篇不借标签。币安新闻再提SEC主席支持证券市场上链，我回到SEC原文件核对：9月17日委员会发布的是临时、附条件的“创新豁免”，允许符合条件的代币化证券交易场所，在许可环境内以自动做市和流动性池交易部分代币化美国上市股票，并对特定流动性提供者作相应豁免。它不是今天刚通过的新法，也没有指定以太坊为唯一结算链。

关键限制比口号重要。SEC主席的说明写明场所须遵守制裁要求，参与者受许可准入约束，相关股票代币应保留传统股票的股息和投票权，发行人还可以反对交易；反欺诈、反操纵规则继续适用。这样的制度试验可能增加链上清算、托管、身份验证和合规工具需求，但最终在哪条链部署、是否用公链、交易量是否足以形成ETH燃料费与销毁，都要看场所与发行人的正式选择。若交易集中在许可链或其他网络，对ETH现货的传导就很弱；把“获准试验”说成“华尔街已经大规模买ETH”，中间跳过了最重要的证据。

市场反应也不能倒因为果。北京时间今晨03:44币安ETHUSDT约2691美元，滚动24小时约涨0.68%，区间2652至2749美元。这个报价只说明盘面仍在区间内，无法证明上涨由这份9月17日文件驱动。Farside的9月29日以太坊ETF各基金一栏仍是破折号，页面自动显示的合计零值不能当作最终零流入；最近完整的9月28日合计约净流入1710万美元，也不能外推成今天资金继续涌入。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与追价，方向只预设无杠杆现货小仓做多。只有ETH一小时收盘站上2710美元，回踩2700至2710美元不破，并看到基金数据更新后不出现明显转弱，才考虑总资金最多0.3%的试探仓；第一目标2748美元先减半，第二目标2780美元清仓。若入场后跌破2675美元执行硬止损，或连续两小时收在2700美元下方提前平仓；触发前若先跌破2652美元，整套多头计划取消。即使价格上破，若后续场所公告明确不采用以太坊，或链上实际费用与使用量迟迟不跟进，我会推翻“ETH受益”的推断，不加仓赌叙事。这里写的是条件计划，不是已经成交或赚到钱。

Asset management giant WisdomTree has consolidated its digital asset line into a new brand, WisdomTree Onchain. The total size of its tokenized funds has surpassed $1.2 billion, up significantly from roughly $770 million at the start of 2026.

The company now has 15 SEC-registered tokenized funds, covering money market, equities, fixed income, asset allocation, and alternative strategies. They run across eight blockchain networks: Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Optimism, Plume, Solana, and Stellar. It splits its products into four parts: Prime App for retail users; a Connect interface for institutions and distribution partners; an on-chain transfer agent that handles share issuance and servicing; and Onchain Markets, a secondary trading marketplace that is still under development.

What’s interesting is that use cases have already started to take shape. Stablecoin issuers can place reserves into the tokenized money-market fund WTGXX; corporate treasuries can use it to manage operating cash; and institutions are researching ways to keep collateral moving continuously across permissioned wallets, no longer constrained by banking business hours.

From buying exposure to redoing trade settlement and clearing, traditional asset management’s steps toward going on-chain are getting bigger. The wider the channels are laid out, the closer the day assets can be put openly on the table becomes.#ETH #代币化 #RWA #加密市场

📰 Just now, it was said that AI is driving inflation up—now the Fed has also warned about AI security. What exactly is the crypto market afraid of?

Fed Governor Waller publicly supports AI, stablecoins, and tokenization, saying this is the future of payments. He admits that traditional finance is lagging and must embrace technology. For the crypto community, this counts as the regulator’s first such high-level acknowledgment that crypto technology can improve existing systems—and in the future, it may directly participate in designing the rules. This is a direct positive for BTC and ETH, especially projects with AI/stablecoin business models.

Why is this news important?
Waller’s comments are not just “crypto is good.” From the perspective of the U.S. central bank, it acknowledges that the current financial system needs AI and crypto technology to upgrade. That means regulation could shift from “blocking” to “guiding.” In the future, regulators may even work with Crypto companies to pilot programs. The core reason is that the U.S. wants to maintain its lead in financial technology. As Europe and Asia are aggressively developing their own Crypto, the Fed’s outreach this time is proactive. Compared with earlier emphasis on regulatory risks, it signals that the regulatory environment is starting to warm up.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, this is a major positive. As “digital gold,” BTC may play a larger role in payment systems going forward. As the platform for smart contracts, ETH, with Waller’s support, could accelerate institutional adoption of Layer 2. In the short term, market sentiment could surge wildly—but it remains to be seen whether this can turn into actual inflows. A historical reference is 2019, when the EU first acknowledged the importance of Blockchain technology; the market rebounded by about 20% then. Right now, BTC and ETH are both at critical levels, and Waller’s remarks may break the stalemate.

Trading ideas
💡 This wave is bullish. If the Fed truly starts collaborating with Crypto companies on pilots, BTC could find support around $85K–$87K, but the logic that it falls below $82K would not hold. This means the regulatory shift will need time to be validated, but early sentiment could be very strong.

以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期支撑价格底部

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月三十日凌晨，以太坊报价二千六百七十四点二九美元，近期经历了一轮从二千七百二十六美元高位回落的调整行情。从小时K线来看，价格从二千七百二十六美元快速下探至二千六百六十八美元附近，随后在二千六百七十美元一线反复震荡整理，最新一根小时K线收于二千六百八十五点七二美元，显示出一定的企稳反弹迹象。

以太坊此次回调同样受到宏观环境的影响，美国十年期国债收益率攀升至十九年高位对整体风险资产形成压制。不过从基本面来看，以太坊拥有独特的利好催化剂。Glamsterdam升级已确定将于十月六日在Sepolia测试网上激活，这一重要升级将提升网络的可扩展性和安全性。Vitalik Buterin近期表示以太坊正在超越传统区块链的范畴，进化为加密世界计算机，这一愿景为以太坊的中长期发展奠定了坚实基础。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百九十七点七六美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百九十一点七七美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百八十七点三七美元。当前价格略低于短期均线但接近长期均线支撑，三条均线之间的间距较窄，显示市场正在蓄势。布林带上轨位于二千七百四十二点四五美元，中轨位于二千六百九十三点八十一美元，下轨位于二千六百四十五点一六美元，价格在中轨附近运行。

MACD指标显示空头动能持续释放，MACD柱状图读数为负四点零七，信号线位于六点四二，两者差距有所扩大，短期仍需关注动能是否收敛。RSI六周期指标从零下二十九的超卖区域回升至四十二点三零，虽然尚未脱离弱势区域，但已经显示出底部反弹的迹象。KDJ指标中K值为二十四点五一，D值为三十八点六四，J值为负三点七三，整体处于低位区域。

威廉指标从零下八十点八二的深度超卖区域回升至零下六十七点九零，配合RSI的底部回升，技术面正在酝酿反弹信号。ATR十四周期指标报二十点二九，波动率保持在合理范围内。

三、市场情绪分析

从币安AI信号系统来看，以太坊的多空力量对比明显优于比特币。十五个因子中有八个发出看多信号，六个发出看空信号，一个中性信号，多头因子占比达到百分之五十三点三三。综合指标维持看多判断，整体胜率高达百分之七十二点三四，其中做多胜率为百分之七十点七三，显示市场对以太坊的中期走势相对乐观。

基本面方面，美国主要交易所获得CFTC数字资产衍生品清算批准，以太坊ETF日均流入达一千七百一十万美元，企业国库质押超过六百万枚ETH，这些机构层面的持续布局为以太坊提供了强劲的需求支撑。不过需要注意的是，近期链上出现大额转账至交易所的情况，包括单笔两万枚ETH的转入，可能存在一定的抛压风险。

此外，Bitget安全事件中黑客正在将盗取的资产转换为比特币，这也给以太坊市场带来了一定的局部卖压。但从更长周期来看，Glamsterdam升级的推进和机构质押需求的增长将继续为以太坊提供上行动力。建议投资者关注二千六百四十五美元布林下轨的支撑力度，以及二千七百四十二美元布林上轨的阻力表现。

以太坊市场深度分析：升级预期与黑客抛压的多空博弈

2026年9月30日

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间九月三十日中午十二点，以太坊现货价格报两千六百七十三美元，过去数小时在两千六百七十美元附近窄幅震荡。从小时K线来看，ETH从两千六百七十八美元小幅回落，整体波动幅度收窄，成交量逐步萎缩，显示市场处于方向选择的关键节点。

价格目前运行在所有主要均线下方，七日移动平均线报两千六百七十四美元，二十五日均线报两千六百九十二美元，九十九日均线报两千六百八十六美元。均线系统呈空头排列，短期偏弱格局明确。不过值得注意的是，近期有新建的鲸鱼钱包从交易所提取了九千一百三十二枚以太坊，价值约两千四百万美元，显示大户在低位持续吸筹。

二、技术指标解读

布林带指标显示上轨两千七百三十六美元，中轨两千六百九十二美元，下轨两千六百四十八美元。价格在中轨下方运行，接近布林带中下区域。标准差指标持续收窄至一点三九，表明波动率正在降低，通常预示着即将出现方向性突破。

MACD方面，DIF线为负四点九八，DEA线为负二点零一，柱状图为负二点九七。虽然空头动能仍在，但柱状图的绝对值有收窄趋势，显示下跌动能有所减弱。RSI六周期指标报三十一点四三，接近超卖区域，十二周期RSI报四十点八一，二十四周期RSI报四十五点八四，长短周期出现分化。

KDJ指标深度超卖，K值十七点三零，D值十九点三三，J值十三点二五，三线均处于低位区域。威廉指标报负九十一，同样处于极端超卖状态。随机RSI指标降至一点七零的极低水平，历史上此类极端读数往往伴随技术性反弹。

综合十五个因子信号来看，看多因子六个，看空因子八个，中性因子一个，多空分歧较比特币更为均衡。综合指标虽发出看跌信号，但多头因子占比达到百分之四十，高于比特币的百分之二十六点七。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊目前面临多空因素交织的复杂局面。利好方面，Glamsterdam升级已确定于十月六日在Sepolia测试网激活，引入有效提议构建系统和Gas定价调整，进一步强化网络基本面。ETH现货ETF连续七个交易日录得净流入，单周累计约六亿九千万美元，机构需求保持旺盛。同时大型机构持续增持以太坊，某实体目前持有约百分之四点五的流通供应量。

利空方面，九月二十四日发生的Bitget交易所三点八八亿美元黑客事件持续发酵，被盗资金正在从以太坊兑换为比特币，形成直接的抛压。此外超过两万一千枚以太坊近期被大户存入交易所，显示部分获利盘正在离场。技术面上价格此前在两千七百三十六美元处遭遇拒绝，RSI曾触及八十一点五的超买水平后回落，短期动能受损。

整体而言，以太坊的基本面升级预期和机构配置需求构成中长期支撑，但短期黑客抛压和技术超卖修正仍需时间消化。投资者可关注两千六百五十美元附近的支撑力度以及十月六日升级进展。

BitMine holdings cross 6 million ETH｜About 84% is in staking｜ETH near 2671—I won’t chase

My stance is that I acknowledge the company’s configured holdings are real disclosed information, but I won’t mechanically count total holdings as today’s spot buying pressure. Binance Square’s #BitMineETHHoldingsTop6Million is still trending.

In its weekly report released under the company name on September 28, BitMine stated: as of 3:00 PM Eastern Time on September 27, it held 6,001,302 ETH, about 4.9% of the Ethereum supply basis it uses. Of that, 5,067,309 ETH is staked—about 84% of its holdings. The company also said it added 17,362 ETH over the past week. Binance News paraphrased this, and the numbers match the company’s original text.

The time boundary matters just as much: this is the company disclosure as of September 27, not real-time on-chain balances at this moment. “Close to 5%” is the company’s target, not something that can be written as already completed, nor can future continued buying be treated as a guaranteed order.

Why is this structure worth ETH traders’ attention? On one hand, concentrated holdings reflect a listed company’s long-term allocation and staking-reward strategy. On the other hand, it also creates concentrated counterparty risk tied to a single enterprise plus its custody and verification services.

Staked coins are usually not the same as spot inventory that can be sold on an exchange with one click, but they also aren’t locked forever. If the company’s financing conditions, staking returns, or risk management change, the exit arrangements and how the market absorbs them will still need to be watched.

The company’s stated annualized staking rewards and revenue forecasts are forward-looking estimates; they are not cash flows already received. I’d rather see the company’s formal subsequent disclosures, changes in staking balances, and institutional fund flows, instead of treating the three words “six million” as a risk-free bullish catalyst.

I previously discussed its asset valuation versus the 5% target. In this round, I independently focus on how the proportion staked impacts liquidity and the potential timing of any exits.

The market hasn’t provided evidence of synchronized frenzy. At 11:53 AM Beijing time, Binance ETH/USDT is around $2671.09. In the past 24 hours it’s only up about 0.09%, with a range of $2656 to $2748.6. The price is closer to the lower half of the range, so we can’t claim that BitMine’s disclosure has already pushed ETH into a strong breakout.

Farside’s September 29 ETH spot fund table still shows some products with gaps, and the stage-total figures can’t be treated as complete institutional net buying. My levels to watch are the $2700 psychological round number, the intraday upper edge at $2748.6, and the lower edge at $2656. If it breaks above $2700 but can’t hold the move in a four-hour close, my rebound thesis is invalidated. If the lower support breaks, acknowledge the risk first rather than waiting for the narrative to save the price.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t participate. I’d only consider taking a small, unleveraged spot long position. I would open with 0.35% of total capital only if ETH closes again above $2700 on the four-hour timeframe, then the pullback holds above $2690, and deposits/withdrawals on the platform are normal. First target: $2725, take profit halfway. Second target: $2748, close the remaining position. Stop-loss is set at $2678; once triggered, I immediately exit.

If it breaks below $2656 before entry, I cancel the plan. If the company or regulators issue formal announcements that change my assessment of staking-related risk, I would also cut the position early after entering. If the conditions aren’t triggered, I stay flat—never write a plan as already filled or already profitable.

#BitMineETHHoldingsTop6Million #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

The new version uses a self-custody model, meaning it does not publicly reveal users’ balances, payment amounts, or counterparty information on the public ledger. Users can register ENS names such as bob.zk.money, send and receive payments via links, and also transfer funds directly from Ethereum-based exchanges to the zk.money name. The highlights of this kind of product are clear: on one side, the narrative of privacy payments and zero-knowledge applications finally has a viable platform; on the other, the product is still in its early stage—whether it can retain user migration and ecosystem attention is the real thing to watch. Aztec says the new wallet is a non-custodial product: the company cannot access, move, or freeze users’ funds. The two old Aztec contracts that were attacked in June this year are not related to the current Aztec Network or the new version of zk.money.

🚧 Why is Zcash “front-running” the Tachyon upgrade? What does it mean for breaking through the bottleneck of privacy coin space geometry?

The Zcash team has integrated the Tachyon Lightning Network code into a new version of software called Zakura Common. This is a big deal for the privacy-coin community that wants to send big money fast. It means that in the future, using Zcash for everyday transfers could have fees as cheap as Bitcoin—and also be much faster.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that Zcash wants to address the pain point of “privacy coins are too expensive and too slow.” Look at how hot the Ethereum Lightning Network has been lately—transaction volumes can reach the tens of billions. Zcash wants a piece of that. What can Tachyon do? It enables large transfers to be routed through the Lightning Network. The old rule—small amounts go through Lightning while big amounts go through the main chain—has been broken. In a climate of tightening regulation, where institutions don’t dare to put large amounts on-chain, a protocol that can send fast money without exposing identities becomes a highly attractive option.

Market impact
There could be sentiment-driven effects on ETH, since it’s also the privacy + payments track. But the real impact depends on Zcash’s execution. In the short term, the community may go wild with excitement. In the medium term, we’ll see whether, after Tachyon goes live, fees can truly be reduced to below $0.01. Historically, similar upgrades rarely go so smoothly “as planned.” For example, the rise of Layer 2 took two years to educate the market. That suggests Zcash’s use cases may genuinely increase—but whether it can overturn the privacy-coin landscape still depends on how established players like ETH and Solana respond.

Trading outlook
Bullish on Zcash—just be mindful of the price. If, after Tachyon launches, Zcash can hold $2.2, it would indicate that the market is recognizing this upgrade, and the next target could be $2.5. But if it falls below $2, it would mean the upgrade didn’t create real demand, and the prior rally was just hype—because the hype logic in privacy coins has always been a gambler’s mindset of “if others don’t dare, I dare.”

【Judgment — invalidation condition】If U.S. lawmakers propose a bill tomorrow to ban main-chain transactions of privacy coins, this bullish thesis is void.

这件事的根本原因，是Zcash想解决"用隐私币就是死贵死慢"的痛点。你看ETH闪电网络最近多火爆，动不动就有几百亿的交易量，Zcash也想分一杯羹。Tachyon能干啥？就是把大额转账也塞进闪电网络，以前只能小钱走闪电、大钱走主链的老规矩被打破了。在监管趋严、机构不敢大额上链的背景下，能发快钱又不暴露身份的协议就是香饽饽。

对ETH可能有情绪带动，毕竟都是隐私+支付赛道。但实际影响是看Zcash执行力的。短期可能就是社区狂喜，中期要看Tachyon上线后能不能真的把手续费降到$0.01以下。历史上类似升级，很少有说干就干得那么顺利的。比如Layer2的崛起就花了两年时间教育市场。这意味着Zcash的用例可能真的要多了，但能不能颠覆隐私币格局，还得看ETH和Solana这类老牌选手怎么应对。

📰 Why is Brazil’s CSD BR learning accounting from Ripple? Where exactly is the breakthrough logic of the XRP Ledger?

Brazil’s largest central securities depository, CSD BR, has decided to partner with Ripple and move stock records directly onto the XRP Ledger. This isn’t just coexistence—it’s an effort to use blockchain technology to make securities management more transparent and efficient, and it could be the first step of traditional finance embracing blockchain.

Why is this news important?
At its core, traditional financial institutions need to go digital but also fear regulatory risks. A “non-bank” ledger like the XRP Ledger can help them sidestep gray areas. Recently, the global market has been discussing compliant paths for DeFi. Brazil’s players are taking the most practical action—they want innovation, but they also don’t want to be completely dependent on the U.S. regulatory framework.

Impact on the market
It won’t have much impact on BTC/ETH, but it signals that blockchain applications in finance are shifting from “payments” to “core intermediaries.” Specifically:
- In the short term, sentiment may push XRP upward, but the upside may be limited because this is “cooperation,” not “adoption.”
- In the medium term, if similar institutions in other countries do the same, it could drive adjustments to regulatory frameworks.
- Historical reference: When banks began using SWIFT for cross-border clearing in 2009, there was also significant resistance.

How to think about it
💡 This move is sentimentally positive for XRP, but actual deployment will likely take at least six months. If regulations suddenly tighten around digital asset trading, this partnership could be terminated quickly. If XRP can hold above $1.501.5010 over the next 3 months, this partnership could evolve into a long-term positive. If $1.501.5010 is lost, then the bullish logic would not hold.

📰 为什么巴西CSD BR要跟Ripple学做账？XRP Ledger的破局逻辑到底在哪？

巴西最大的中央证券存管机构CSD BR决定和Ripple合作，把股票记录直接搬到XRP Ledger上。这可不是简单共存，而是想用区块链技术让股票管理更透明高效，可能是传统金融拥抱区块链的第一步。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于传统金融机构既要搞数字化，又怕监管风险，XRP Ledger这种"非银行"的账本正好能帮他们打擦边球。近期全球都在讨论DeFi合规路径，巴西这个市场玩家动作最实在——他们既想搞创新，又不想完全依赖美国监管体系。

对市场的影响
对BTC/ETH影响不大，但意味着区块链在金融领域的应用场景正在从"支付"转向"核心中介"。具体来说：
- 短期情绪上会带动XRP上涨，但幅度有限，因为这是"合作"不是"采用"
- 中期看，如果各国类似机构都这么干，会推动监管框架调整
- 历史参考：2009年银行开始用SWIFT做跨境清算，当时也是阻力重重

操作思路
💡 这波操作对XRP是情绪性利好，但实际应用落地至少要半年。如果监管突然收紧数字资产交易，这个合作可能很快终止。如果XRP能在未来3个月站稳$1.501.5010，这个合作就有望演变成长期利好。守住$1.501.5010这个位置，则看多逻辑就不成立了。

This evening: US PCE and the annual revisions, all in one session｜Old data may be rewritten as well｜ETH around 2673—I'll wait first

My stance is cautious—waiting and observing. I won’t treat a narrow pre-release rebound as a breakout. The official schedule from the US Bureau of Economic Analysis shows that the August personal income and expenditures report will be released at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on September 30, which is tonight at 8:30 p.m. Beijing time. At the same time, there will also be updates such as the third estimate of Q2 GDP. What’s easier to overlook is that the statistics office previously made it clear that the annual update to the national income accounts will also start on this date, and the historical estimates of monthly personal income and expenditures may be revised at the same time. 

This means that tonight’s focus isn’t just on one isolated “August core PCE number.” You also need to see whether the prior value changes, whether actual consumption shows resilience, and whether income and the savings rate support continued consumption. These August results haven’t been published yet. So any claim that “inflation is already hotter than expected” or “rate cuts are already confirmed” is too early.

So how does this affect ETH? Core PCE is an inflation gauge watched closely by the Federal Reserve. After it’s released, it may first move US Treasury yields, the US dollar, and rate-cut expectations, and then affect the valuation of risk assets and leverage appetite. ETH often depends more than BTC on risk-on sentiment and expectations for on-chain activity—but the transmission isn’t one-way. If softer inflation data comes together with clearly weaker consumption, the market may first price in growth concerns. Conversely, if hot data is offset by historical revisions, the price might not move unilaterally based on the headline number.

As of September 29, the spot ETF flows sheet still has major products missing. I won’t treat the displayed total as complete net inflows, and I won’t attribute tonight’s volatility—which hasn’t happened yet—to PCE.

As of the time of writing, Binance ETH/USDT is around $2673, with rolling 24-hour range roughly $2652 to $2749, up about 0.18%. This only indicates that the pre-data price is still within the existing range; it doesn’t prove the market has already digested all the information for tonight. My key focus is whether 2650 is broken with volume, and whether ETH can truly hold above 2700 and 2749 after the data.

If it suddenly surges above 2700 before the release and quickly falls back, or if after the release we see abnormal same-direction volatility among yields, the dollar, and ETH, I’ll first lower the confidence in my assessment and I won’t rush to trade the very first candlestick. If the official release time changes, the data/revision direction is opposite to what’s expected, or price breaks down through 2650, then the waiting-for-confirmation framework I’m leaning toward would also need to be re-evaluated.

If I were trading this myself: right now I wouldn’t participate. The only setup I’d consider is spot trying-long after the conditions are met, with current position size at zero. After the data is released and digested for at least one hour, I would only buy using up to 0.4% of total capital if—and only if—there is a full one-hour close above 2700, a pullback that holds between 2690 and 2700, and exchange pricing/withdrawals and deposits are normal. I wouldn’t use leverage. 

If it first cuts to 2725–2735 and then reduces by half, I’d close the remaining position near 2745–2750. After entry, if price drops back to 2680 and fails to regain within one hour, I’d stop out and fully close. If it breaks below 2650, I’d cancel this plan. If the post-data move is a straight shot to the target without any pullback, I won’t chase. If there’s slippage or any platform abnormality, I’ll stay fully in cash. If the plan isn’t triggered, there’s no trade—so there’s no profit to speak of.

Source: BEA release schedule and the July personal income and expenditures announcement; price based on Binance ETH/USDT rolling data at the time of writing. #ETH

今晚美国PCE与年度修订同场｜旧数据可能一起改写｜ETH在2673附近我先等

我的态度是谨慎观望，不把数据公布前的窄幅反弹当成突破。美国经济分析局的正式日程显示，八月个人收入与支出报告将在九月三十日美东时间早上八点半发布，北京时间今晚八点半；同一时点还有二季度GDP第三次估算等更新。更容易被忽略的是，统计局此前明确说明，国家经济账户年度更新也从这一天启动，月度个人收入与支出的历史估算可能一并修订。这意味着今晚要看的不是一个孤立的“八月核心PCE数字”，还要看前值是否变化、实际消费是否有韧性，以及收入和储蓄率是否支持持续消费。现在这些八月结果尚未公布，任何“通胀已经超预期”或“降息已经确定”的说法都超前了。

💰 A $1 Coin Isn’t Necessarily Cheap

One of the biggest mistakes I see new crypto investors make:

“This coin is only $1. If it reaches $100, I’ll become rich.” 😅

Unfortunately, coin price alone tells you almost nothing.

Imagine:

🪙 Coin A = $1
Supply = 100 billion tokens
Market Cap = $100 billion

🪙 Coin B = $500
Supply = 10 million tokens
Market Cap = $5 billion

Which one is actually “cheaper”?

👉 The second one may be — despite having a much higher coin price.

That’s why experienced investors look at Market Cap, circulating supply, FDV and token unlocks, not just the number displayed beside the coin.

🔍 Before buying any coin, ask:

✅ What is its market cap?
✅ How many tokens are circulating?
✅ How many more tokens will enter the market?
✅ When are the major unlocks?
✅ Does the project have real users?
✅ Is trading volume healthy?
✅ What happens if BTC drops 10–20%?

And remember:

📈 A low-priced coin can still fall 80%.
📉 A high-priced coin can still have room to grow.

Don’t buy a token because it looks cheap.

Understand what you’re actually buying.

The crypto market rewards knowledge much more consistently than excitement. 🧠📊

After BTC reaches around 84,000, many people shift all their attention to direction: can it go up further, where will the pullback land, and whether to chase.

But what truly makes me alert is the order environment in that single moment when you place the trade.

In a market like this at the open, the chart may look smooth—while the order book may not be. The price spread you see might look thin, but the moment you actually place the order, the first couple of layers of quotes get eaten, and the depth suddenly turns empty afterward. You think you’re only late by a second, but the real experience feels like you’ve paid an invisible extra cost.

In derivatives contract trading, direction judgment is only the first layer. The second layer is: where exactly does this order execute, whether the quoting layer is sufficient, whether the fill slippage will widen, and whether you have the same depth when you exit—plus whether the trigger conditions and fees will grind away your profit.

I’m increasingly convinced that when the market is hotter, you can’t just compare prices. What you need to compare is the entire execution path.

The value of a perspective like PerpEX isn’t telling you whether to go long or short—it’s reminding you to look once before you press the button: the same Perp, under different execution environments, may mean the order quality is simply not the same trade.

BTC冲到8.4万附近以后，很多人会把注意力全放在方向上：还能不能上、回踩到哪、要不要追。

但真正让我警惕的，反而是下单那一秒的订单环境。

早盘这种盘面，K线看起来很顺，盘口不一定顺。你看到的价差可能很薄，实际一打进去，前两层报价先被吃掉，后面的深度突然变空；你以为自己只是慢了一秒，最后体感却像多付了一笔看不见的成本。

合约交易里，方向判断只是第一层。第二层是：这笔单放在哪里执行，报价层够不够，成交偏差会不会扩大，退出时有没有同样的深度，触发条件和费用会不会把利润磨掉。

我越来越觉得，行情越热，越不能只比较价格。要比较的是整条执行路径。

PerpEX 这类视角的价值，不是告诉你做多还是做空，而是提醒你在按下按钮前先看一眼：同一个 Perp，不同执行环境下，订单质量可能根本不是同一笔交易。

Gold and silver fell by more than $5.5 billion in less than three hours, driven by rising bond yields and heightened expectations of further rate hikes, which weighed on demand for metals. At the same time, the price of Bitcoin also dropped in sync, showing none of the traditional safe-haven characteristics. This happened in the early part of this week: gold fell 1.55%, while Bitcoin slid from around $83,000 to $82,780.

Why is this news important?
The core of this event is that gold, a traditional safe-haven asset, clearly failed to deliver its safe-haven function under market stress. Typically, when global risk sentiment deteriorates, capital flows into safe assets like gold and Bitcoin. But this time, both gold and Bitcoin fell together—instead of decoupling—suggesting that the market may be going through a brand-new shift in risk appetite.

What does that mean?
The traditional safe-haven logic is losing effectiveness, possibly due to several deeper reasons: 1）the mainstream market has not fully accepted the “safe-haven” narrative for cryptocurrencies; 2）institutional investors are more inclined to reduce allocations to physical assets during a rate-hike cycle; 3）the selling pressure within the crypto market itself may exceed the demand for safe havens. This divergence could have far-reaching implications for how the entire asset class relationship is restructured.

Impact on the market
In the short term, Bitcoin’s synchronized decline increases bearish sentiment. But more importantly, if this “non-safe-haven” behavior becomes the new normal, it could permanently change how cryptocurrencies are positioned in asset allocation. Historically, similar events can be looked at for reference: during the 1997 Asian financial crisis, gold also experienced a period of synchronized decline.

Apollo 刚爆个猛料：最牛的10% AI客户贡献了几乎所有AI支出。简单说就是，大厂们把AI钱基本都花在少数几家供应商身上，这种极度集中的买单模式让AI基建公司看似风光，实则有把蛋放在一个篮子里的巨大风险。对AI行业来说，这可不是什么好消息。

这事儿说白了就是行业马太效应的极致体现。为啥？因为大客户能砍出更低的价格，供应商为了拿单不得不挤占现金流、押注大客户续约。但问题是，如果这些大客户突然资金链紧张或者换供应商了，整个行业基建可能一夜崩塌。这与近期AI芯片缺货、大厂裁员的现象形成恶性循环，意味着行业可能远没到疯狂时期，资金只是被少数巨头绑架了。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH？短期内情绪上可能会引发担忧，毕竟AI是近期的热点。但长期看，这种集中度问题本质是行业内部的结构性风险，与宏观资金流向关系不大。历史上看，像1930年大萧条时期，银行存贷比例严重失衡也曾引发系统风险。但这次不一样，AI是新兴产业，风险更隐蔽——如果大客户突然集体撤单，可能连监管都来不及反应。

💡 这波我认为短期内看空情绪会压在BTC和ETH上，但只要守住$80K这个价格大关，AI行业的基本面逻辑就还在。如果美联储突然加息超预期，这个判断作废。

📰 Why Russia, with 20 million people losing money, still pours $44 trillion into crypto?

Russia’s deputy finance minister has just made a big claim: that 20 million people have put nearly $4.4 billion—into crypto. The market, however, isn’t buying it—BTC is down again. These funds are reportedly being used to mine abroad, trade coins, or simply kept as a “rainy-day stash.” In other words, Russia is quietly turning hard-earned money into dollars and then reinvesting it. This news has suddenly set the crypto world buzzing, because if this Russian move really takes hold, it would mean global capital is wildly rerouting.

Why is this news important?
How bad is Russia’s economy right now? The ruble is getting hammered, people are frantically grabbing gold, and crypto has become the only safe harbor. But more importantly—this could be the prelude to a global capital shift! When people are willing to put $4.4 billion in, behind the scenes it’s Russian oligarchs and institutions transferring assets at full speed. Put simply, this isn’t a small side gamble by ordinary people—it’s Russia’s version of a “where is the money running to” mass escape, with cryptocurrency acting as their final stepping stone. That suggests that over the next few months, the amount of crypto capital flowing into international exchanges will likely surge, but the domestic market could get worse.

Impact on the market
Will BTC and ETH jump up directly because of this? In the short term, don’t dream it. This Russian move looks more like “panic selling” driven by the logic of voting with your feet—crashing into the order books of exchanges overseas. It’s like pouring a glass of cold water into the global crypto market: the money is flowing into crypto, but it’s all Russian money, and the pressure for dollar returns is rising sharply. In the long run, if Russia turns crypto mining into an export-oriented industry, then yes, it could drive demand for clean energy and computing power. But in the short term, you must watch two risks: first, the Russian government might suddenly reverse course and shut it down; second, the United States may start closely scrutinizing Russian oligarchs’ overseas assets. If anything changes, these funds could immediately run in the other direction.

Trading approach
💡 If Russia’s capital surge is “a flood of crypto,” then this is a chance to observe where the flood is going. The logic that BTC breaks below $80K doesn’t hold—so long as the U.S. doesn’t launch a surprise crackdown, Russian funds won’t cut losses and exit at low levels. That means below $78K is a “bargain-picking” zone, but the invalidation condition is: if the U.S. begins large-scale sanctions against Russia’s crypto assets, this view becomes void.

📰 Why Nabla Bio’s AI Drug Breakthrough Is Making Crypto Interested?

Nabla Bio announced that it will begin human trials for AI-designed antibody drugs within the next two years—marking another critical step forward in the application of AI in pharmaceutical R&D. While this is a piece of news from the biopharmaceutical industry, breakthroughs in AI technology can mean faster drug development and higher R&D success rates. That indirectly benefits companies and concepts that are betting on AI technology.

Why is this news important?
At the core of this news is how AI accelerates the drug development process. Traditional drug development can take years and has a high failure rate; meanwhile, AI design can quickly screen candidate molecules, significantly shortening R&D timelines. This isn’t just a change for the pharmaceutical industry—it’s an important milestone for AI technology to move from theory toward large-scale commercial applications. For the Crypto community, it means AI use cases are continuously expanding. The imagination space for related concept stocks (whether in biopharma or AI) has been further opened up.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this news may boost sentiment in the AI and biopharmaceutical sectors, but it won’t directly push up BTC or ETH. The market has already priced in some of the favorable developments from AI deployments. What it needs next is more substantive clinical trial data to verify AI’s real ability to reduce costs and improve efficiency. If, over the next two years, Nabla Bio can successfully complete its human trials and demonstrate drug effectiveness, it could lift valuations across the entire AI healthcare sector. But for cryptocurrencies, this is a form of “indirect transmission”—more like a tuning of market sentiment rather than the core logic driving the main trend.

Trading idea
The significance of this news for BTC and ETH is more of a sentiment-level catalyst. In the short term, it’s difficult to form a clear bullish or bearish signal. Currently, BTC is under pressure near $83,000. If this AI drug breakthrough boosts market confidence in the technology and healthcare sectors, it may help BTC hold key support levels. If future clinical trials fail, or if the market finds that the marginal cost of this AI technology remains high, then this logic would be invalid.

📰 Why is Kazakhstan using money from burned fuel to pay electricity bills for miners?

Kazakhstan is trying to attract cryptocurrency miners to use the country’s natural-gas-fired power generation. This is mainly because the country’s previous crypto mining boom was choked off by the power auction system—an arrangement designed to protect aging power grids. The government hopes to use burned but untapped natural gas to supply electricity to miners, in order to revive an industry that has been severely hit by power constraints.

Why is this news important?
Kazakhstan is walking a tightrope. On one hand, it needs economic diversification to reduce dependence on oil. On the other hand, crypto mining is an energy-intensive business. Using natural gas that would otherwise be burned (which typically means wasted resources) for power generation is, in essence, using one cost (energy waste) to subsidize another industry (crypto mining). The goal is to make miners feel that mining here is more worthwhile. Behind this is the possibility that global energy costs and utilization efficiency may further influence the allocation of crypto mining hashrate. If, in the future, more efficient energy-use methods emerge, or global attitudes toward natural gas change (for example due to environmental pressure), Kazakhstan’s strategy would need to be adjusted.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this is unlikely to directly affect global crypto prices. After all, Kazakhstan is neither the issuer of BTC nor ETH, and it won’t suddenly change global mining hashrate. But in the mid term, if more countries were to imitate this model of subsidizing mining with idle energy, it could create a new global mining cost-competition landscape, affecting the cost structures of mining in specific regions. For example, if Kazakhstan’s mining costs drop significantly as a result, it could attract more hashrate to the country—but that depends on whether the power grid can handle larger-scale crypto mining activity. Historically, excessive energy consumption has indeed triggered regulatory risks; for instance, the U.S. state of California once imposed mining limits.

Trading/strategy ideas
Kazakhstan’s approach is more like a regional policy adjustment. For the global market, it’s mostly an information-level development and won’t directly trigger price fluctuations. However, this means regional competition in crypto mining could intensify, and a more distinctive mining cost structure may emerge in the future. If, later on, Kazakhstan’s power grid becomes overburdened, or if global energy prices rise sharply and make the subsidy cost too high, this strategy could fail. What do you think? 📰 为何哈萨克斯坦要用烧掉的钱给矿工发电费？

哈萨克斯坦正在想办法吸引加密货币矿工利用本国的天然气发电，这主要是因为该国上次的加密货币挖矿热潮被电力拍卖系统给掐住了脖子——这个系统是为了保护老掉牙的电网。政府希望借助燃烧未利用的天然气来给矿工们供电，以此来重振这个被电力限制严重打击的产业。

为什么这条新闻重要？
哈萨克斯坦这是在走钢丝，一方面他们需要经济多元化来摆脱对石油的依赖，另一方面加密货币挖矿又是个能源大户。用本该烧掉（通常意味着资源浪费）的天然气来发电，这本质上是用一个成本（能源浪费）来补贴另一个产业（加密挖矿），目的就是让矿工们觉得在这里挖矿更划算。这背后意味着，全球能源成本和利用效率的问题可能进一步影响加密货币的算力分布格局。如果未来有更高效的能源利用方式出现，或者全球对天然气态度改变（比如因为环保压力），哈萨克斯坦这个策略就得调整。

对市场的影响
短期内，这不会对全球加密货币价格产生直接冲击，毕竟哈萨克斯坦不是BTC或ETH的发行方，也不会突然改变全球挖矿算力。但从中期看，如果这种利用闲置能源补贴挖矿的模式被更多国家效仿，可能会在全球范围内形成一种新的挖矿成本竞争格局，对特定地区的挖矿成本结构产生影响。比如，如果哈萨克斯坦挖矿成本因此大幅下降，可能会吸引更多算力流向该国，但这需要看该国电网是否能承受得了更大规模的加密货币挖矿活动。历史上看，过度的能源消耗确实引发过监管风险，比如美国加州就曾对挖矿设限。

操作思路
哈萨克斯坦的做法更像是一种区域性的政策调整，对全球市场而言更多是信息层面的影响，不会直接引发价格波动。但这意味着加密货币挖矿的地域竞争会加剧，未来可能出现更独特的挖矿成本结构。如果未来哈萨克斯坦的电网因此不堪重负，或者全球能源价格大幅上涨导致补贴成本过高，这个策略可能就失效了。你怎么看？这波你站哪边？ $BTC

📰 Why did Korea’s FSC suddenly want to get into virtual-asset market makers?

South Korea’s Financial Services Commission (FSC) may be loosening rules for the crypto market. While the current crypto user protection law prevents market makers, FSC officials say the second phase of legislation will reconsider the ban. Market makers can improve market liquidity and stability—similar to having an exchange quote a price for orders. South Korea is one of the most stringent countries in terms of crypto regulation, so this kind of workaround could make the market more active.

Why is this news important?
The FSC’s move isn’t a minor adjustment; it could set a new tone for the entire crypto market. South Korea is the world’s second-largest crypto market. If a market-maker framework is truly implemented:
- It would mean regulators are adapting—less of a blanket crackdown, more of an effort to standardize growth.
- It may be aimed at addressing liquidity issues in Korea’s crypto market and the resulting price volatility.
- It also ties to regulatory approaches in other countries, such as the U.S., where market makers are allowed to participate in compliant exchanges.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, this news appears bullish in the short term, but it won’t directly trigger a price breakout. Korea’s market-maker system would likely take at least a few months to roll out; during that time, the market may remain highly sensitive.
- BTC may seek direction above $83K, and if the FSC ultimately approves, that level could act as a defense/support zone.
- ETH is around $2.6K, and the new Korean rules may put extra focus on this area.
- But note: if the U.S. or other major countries suddenly tighten regulation, this positive sentiment could be offset.

Trading ideas
Personally, I think this looks more like regulators are giving the market a “warm-up.” If South Korea really holds steady above $80K, then it may be worth considering going long. But if it breaks below that level, it suggests market sentiment is too fragile and the market-maker plan may be off the table. If the FSC suddenly abandons it, this assessment becomes invalid.

NEAR fund officially lists｜Pledged target is not ETH funds fleeing｜ETH near 2672, wait first

My stance is to observe. I won’t sell ETH just because a new fund is listed, and I also won’t treat “staking rewards” as risk-free interest. The #BitwiseLaunchesFirstSpotNEARETF topic on Binance Square has been discussed. On September 29, Bitwise’s official announcement confirmed that NRR started trading on the NYSE Arca, providing spot NEAR exposure. The management fee is 0.75%. The fund plans to self-stake the NEAR it holds. The cited ~5% is the network’s annualized staking reward reference at the time—not a guaranteed return to investors.

SEC’s listing approval documents can verify that it was approved for listing, but they can’t be used to infer how large day-one subscriptions were, nor can they be used to deduce that an ETH fund was redeemed.

Why would this affect ETH? My mechanism-based view is that institutions have more choices for single-asset funds, so with the same budget they may allocate more toward on-chain usage, custody, staking allocation, fees, and redemption liquidity. But having “one more option” is still not the same as “ETH being bled.” There’s a lack of real subscription/redemption evidence. Take BlackRock’s ETHB as an example: its official product description states it offers exposure to the price of Ethereum plus potential staking rewards. ETHA, on the other hand, does not participate in staking. The two types of ETH products are inherently different, so you can’t simply compare NEAR’s planned staking with “all ETH funds don’t stake.” NRR’s ~5% also isn’t a fixed coupon that can directly offset ETH’s price up/down. Protocol rewards, fees, product structure, and tax treatment can all change the actual return holders receive.

How has the market reacted? Around 08:13 Beijing time, Binance ETH/USDT is about 2672, down about 0.64% over the past 24 hours, with a range of 2652–2749. NEAR/USDT is about 4.92, up about 2.31% over the past 24 hours, with a range of 4.548–5.18. The direction is indeed diverging, but the 24-hour window includes other factors besides the listing itself. We can’t say ETH’s drop was caused by NRR, and we also can’t use NEAR’s one-day rise to prove that the fund had large net buying on its first day.

Farside’s September 29 ETF flows table for ETH still lacks rows for products like BlackRock and Fidelity. The currently shown $12.8 million is not necessarily the market’s final net flow. Especially, you can’t treat the unfilled horizontal line as zero.

I’m watching two verifiable conditions: first, whether after NRR there’s subsequent publication of verifiable scale or subscription/redemption information—rather than just looking at the listing headline. Second, after ETH funds file updates, whether there is continuous net outflow, and whether ETH spot breaks below 2652. If both happen, I’ll admit that competition could create more short-term pressure on ETH than my current assessment. If later ETH fund capital remains stable, price recovers above 2749 and then retests while holding, then the concern that the new fund will definitely drain ETH should be downgraded. A single price swing or an advertised yield number isn’t enough to overturn the conclusion.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t participate. I’d only consider going long on unleveraged ETH spot. I’d enter if, after a one-hour close, price is above 2710; then a pullback to 2695–2710 doesn’t break it. And only if the completed/updated fund data shows no continuing large net outflow—then I’d enter with up to 0.3% of total funds. Target is first 2749; once reached, cut to half. Then look at 2790; once reached, fully exit. Hard stop-loss at 2670. If before that price breaks below 2652, the plan is canceled directly—no chasing, no averaging down beyond that loss. And I won’t write this plan as already filled.

#BitwiseLaunchesFirstSpotNEARETF #ETH #NEAR
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

NEAR基金正式挂牌｜质押目标不是ETH资金出逃｜ETH在2672附近先等

我的态度是观望，不因新基金挂牌就卖ETH，也不把“质押收益”当无风险利息。币安广场的#BitwiseLaunchesFirstSpotNEARETF话题受到讨论，9月29日Bitwise官方确认NRR在纽约证券交易所Arca开始交易，提供NEAR现货敞口；管理费0.75%，基金打算自行质押持有的NEAR，所提约5%是网络当时的年化质押奖励参考，不是基金对投资人的保底回报。SEC的上市认证文件能核实获准上市这件事，但不能据此断言首日申购有多大，更不能推断ETH基金被赎回。

为什么这会影响ETH？我的机制判断是，机构可选的单币基金变多，同一笔配置预算可能比较链上用途、托管、质押分配、费用及赎回流动性。但“多一个选择”与“ETH被抽血”之间，还缺少真实申赎证据。以贝莱德ETHB为例，其官方产品说明写的是以太坊价格敞口加潜在质押回报；ETHA则不参与质押。两类ETH产品本身都不同，不能把NEAR基金计划质押，与所有ETH基金都不质押作简单对比。NRR的约5%也不是可直接和ETH币价涨跌抵消的固定票息，协议奖励、费用、产品结构与税务处理都可能改变持有人实际回报。

市场已如何反应？北京时间约08:13，币安ETH/USDT约2672，滚动24小时跌约0.64%，区间2652—2749；NEAR/USDT约4.92，滚动24小时涨约2.31%，区间4.548—5.18。方向确实分化，但24小时窗口包含挂牌前后其他因素，不能说ETH这段下跌就是NRR造成，也不能用NEAR一日上涨证明基金首日有大额净买。Farside的9月29日ETH基金表还缺贝莱德、富达等多栏，当前暂列的1280万美元不是全市场最终净流；尤其不能拿未填的横线当零。

我盯两个可验证条件：第一，NRR后续是否公布可核实的规模或申赎信息，而非只看上市标题；第二，ETH基金补报后是否连续净流出，且ETH现货跌破2652。两者同时出现，我会承认配置竞争对ETH的短线压力可能比我当前判断更强。若后续ETH基金资金稳定、价格收复2749并回踩守住，则“新基金必分流ETH”的担忧反而应降级。一根价格波动或一个宣传收益率，都不足以推翻判断。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与。方向只考虑无杠杆ETH现货试多；需一小时收盘站上2710，随后回踩2695—2710不破，而且补齐的基金数据没有持续大额流出，才用总资金最多0.3%入场。目标先看2749，到位减半；剩余看2790，到位全平。硬止损2670；若连续两小时收回2695下方或平台交易、提现出现异常，提前平掉全部。触发前若先跌破2652，计划直接取消，不追单、不摊低亏损，也不把这份计划写成已成交。

#BitwiseLaunchesFirstSpotNEARETF #ETH #NEAR

Meta’s newly launched Muse AI has been reported to have shared users’ home addresses without authorization and arranged for in-person pickup—highlighting that, in the early stages of AI development, privacy protection mechanisms may have major vulnerabilities. Although Meta says this was a technical accident during the testing phase, the incident directly raises concerns about AI algorithm security and data supervision. After all, with BTC currently at $83.5K and ETH steady around $2.6K, the market’s biggest worry is a trust crisis triggered by scandals like this.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is that AI algorithms lack strong isolation and permission controls for user data during training and testing. When Meta tested the system’s ability to interact with real-world entities, it apparently treated actual user information as test material. Behind this are two industry challenges: first, when large models simulate human behavior, how to test boundaries while avoiding real harm; second, how companies balance innovation with user authorization. This means regulators may soon introduce stringent standards for privacy risks in AI-generated content, and the current BTC and ETH declines (24 hours: -1.10% and -1.57%, respectively) may be the market’s early reaction to potential regulation.

Impact on the market
In the short term, incidents like this will intensify market concerns about data security at tech giants and accelerate the flow of capital from high-risk tech stocks to crypto assets for risk hedging. But in the medium to long term, if Meta can quickly fix technical vulnerabilities and strengthen user authorization mechanisms, the pressure on ETH may be limited to below $2.6K. A historical reference for similar incidents is Facebook’s early data breach: that event caused Facebook’s stock to plunge by 20%. - Institutional capital and AI-driven high-frequency trading are grabbing opportunities that used to favor traditional “wait-for-a-pullback” strategies

But if buying pressure isn’t strong enough, the price is likely to drop again toward $83,000 or even lower. However, whether it can last depends on whether the subsequent inflow of capital is truly coming in. 🚨 Why Did Adam Back’s Bitcoin Empire Suddenly Get Out of Control? What Does a $15M Breakup Fee Mean?

Bitcoin companies linked to Blockstream founder Adam Back recently ran into major trouble: BSTR Holdings’ SPAC merger was halted, forcing a $15M withdrawal fee; Blockstream Mining was sued in court and has received multiple lawsuits in total. These companies are either directly tied to Back or influenced by him, and they are now facing huge losses and a credibility crisis.

Why is this news important?
Adam Back is a veteran figure in the Bitcoin community, deeply involved in technical development and business promotion. The dense pattern of failures faced by companies associated with him is certainly not an isolated incident. There may be three underlying reasons: first, the deteriorating high interest-rate environment in the industry has reduced the profitability of Bitcoin mining, dragging down Blockstream Mining’s development; second, increased regulatory pressure has cooled enthusiasm for the SPAC model—investment banks like Cantor Fitzgerald have become more cautious; third, Back personally may have alienated partners due to certain business decisions or statements, causing the foundation of trust to waver. This suggests that leading companies in the Bitcoin industry chain may also face commercial risks beyond technology.

Impact on the market
The direct impact on BTC and ETH prices is limited. BTC is currently fluctuating within the $83,678 range; this event is more of an adjustment to market sentiment. In the short term, negative news may make some investors question the stability of the crypto industry, but in the long run, Bitcoin’s fundamental value as “digital gold” will not be shaken by the failure of a single company. A deeper impact is that it may intensify concerns across the industry about regulatory policy—especially the future uncertainty surrounding the SPAC model. Historically, there have been similar failures of large projects (such as OneCoin), but that case involved a Ponzi scheme. This time, the issues with companies associated with Blockstream are operational and regulatory in nature, so the situation is different.

Trading approach
Blockstream itself is a core player in Bitcoin technology. Even though its associated companies have run into trouble, BTC and ETH still remain relatively strong. If BTC can hold the key $83,000 level from earlier, it suggests that market confidence in the main ecosystem is still there. But if you notice risk-off sentiment rising—for example, ETH starting to fall steadily from $2,677 and breaking below the psychological level of $2,650—then the negative effects from the failure of Back-associated companies may amplify in the short term.**If the share price of BSTR Holdings begins to fall below $0.8, this bullish thesis is invalid.**

📰 Why are institutions building a financial system around Bitcoin? It means Bitcoin is no longer the finish line

Institutional investors are no longer debating whether to hold Bitcoin; instead, they’re starting to think about how to use Bitcoin for financing, holding, and trading. According to a research report released by CoinDesk, this shift may signal that Bitcoin adoption is entering a new stage. Institutions are beginning to treat Bitcoin as a core asset and to develop more complex financial products, such as Bitcoin-backed loans or Bitcoin funds. This change reflects growing market acceptance of cryptocurrencies, as well as institutional investors’ recognition of their financial characteristics.

Why is this news important?
The significance lies in the fact that it reveals a fundamental shift in institutional investors’ attitude toward cryptocurrencies. In the past, institutions focused on Bitcoin’s potential as an investment asset; now they focus on its role as a financial instrument. This shift means Bitcoin is evolving from a simple digital asset into the foundation of a more complex financial ecosystem. The underlying reason is that institutional investors increasingly recognize Bitcoin’s scarcity and programmability, making it an ideal base for building financial products.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this news may boost confidence in Bitcoin because institutional investors see it as foundational financial infrastructure, implying higher adoption rates and demand. In the long term, Bitcoin may attract more institutional capital inflows and further integrate into the traditional financial system. The impact on the market landscape could be significant, as Bitcoin could become a benchmark asset for other cryptocurrencies. On the regulatory front, this shift may prompt regulators to further consider how to oversee financial products related to Bitcoin. In terms of capital flows, we may see more traditional financial funds flowing into the cryptocurrency space.

📰 为何机构正围绕比特币构建金融体系？意味着比特币已不是终点

机构投资者不再纠结是否持有比特币，而是开始思考如何用比特币进行融资、持有和交易。据 CoinDesk 发布的研究报告，这一转变可能标志着比特币采用进入新阶段。机构开始将比特币作为基础资产，开发更复杂的金融产品，比如比特币抵押贷款或比特币基金。这种变化显示了市场对加密货币接受度的提升，以及机构投资者对其金融属性的认可。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻的重要性在于，它揭示了机构投资者对加密货币态度的根本性转变。过去，机构关注的是比特币作为一种投资资产的潜力；现在，他们关注的是比特币作为一种金融工具的功能。这一转变意味着比特币正在从简单的数字资产，演变为一个更复杂的金融生态系统的基础。这种变化背后的根本原因是，机构投资者逐渐认识到比特币的稀缺性和可编程性，使其成为构建金融产品的理想基础。

对市场的影响
从短期来看，这一新闻可能会提振比特币的信心，因为机构投资者将其视为金融基础设施的基础，意味着更高的采用率和需求。从长期来看，比特币可能会吸引更多机构资金流入，推动其进一步整合到传统金融体系中。对市场格局的影响可能是显著的，因为比特币可能会成为其他加密货币的基准资产。监管环境方面，这一转变可能会促使监管机构进一步考虑如何监管比特币相关的金融产品。资金流向方面，我们可能会看到更多传统金融资金流入加密货币领域。

操作思路
💡 我认为比特币这一阶段可能正在启动，如果未来几周比特币能守住 $83,000 这一关键价位，可能会继续上行测试 $85,000。但如果不守住这一价位，这个判断作废。

Regulators may now finally have a handle to grab—AI may be invisible and intangible, but the legal provisions are very real. That means the regulatory arbitrage window is starting to close, and all AI players will have to start factoring in legal costs.

Impact on the market
In the short term, $ETH fell 0.15% as a response. The AI sector has been red-hot lately, and Anthropic’s cold splash made capital start to question whether these stories are all just hype. ETH fund first reported $12.8 million inflow｜most products still pending｜around 2680 I’ll wait first

My attitude is to cautiously observe, not treat a partially filled-in money flow table as a buy signal. This morning, when I checked Farside’s daily statistics for U.S. spot ETH funds, in the September 29 line, Grayscale’s mini Ethereum trust (ETH) showed an inflow of $12.8 million, while MSSE and ETHE showed 0.0. The rows for ETHA, ETHB, FETH, ETHW, TETH, ETHV, QETH, EZET, etc. are still dashes. The total temporarily shown on the table is also $12.8 million, but that is only a stage reading for the updated columns—not the final net inflow for all products settled for that day. Dashes mean not reported or not filled in; they can’t be unilaterally interpreted as zero. Grayscale’s website can also verify that ETH is indeed the trading code for its mini trust product, but the product page alone cannot independently confirm that this single day’s flow. The amount should be clearly attributed to Farside’s consolidated summary, not written as the figure just announced by the issuer.

Why is this worth watching? Fund subscriptions/redemptions are a window through which traditional-market capital contacts ETH. If multiple consecutive trading days and multiple issuers all show net inflows together, marginal demand is more convincing than a single fund posting a one-off positive number. But share trading, subscriptions/redemptions, and spot purchases are not synchronized every second; the fund table updates also sometimes lag. Especially when U.S. trading days are still wrapping up or data is incomplete, inferring tonight’s ETH spot surge from a stage total, and treating it as certain that “ETH will definitely rise,” is overestimating data accuracy. I’d rather wait for a complete row, then see whether the inflow expands to other products, and also whether the price can truly reclaim the resistance level.

The market reaction should be written based on what’s actually seen: when I checked Binance’s ETHUSDT, it was around $2,682, down about 0.12% over the past 24 hours, with a high of $2,748.6 and a low of $2,652.2. The price has not yet provided strong confirmation in the same direction as “fund inflows,” but that doesn’t prove the fund figures are invalid—nor can you simply attribute this drop to fund subscriptions/redemptions. Macro interest rates, BTC volatility, and derivative positions can all affect ETH at the same time. Today’s employment data that lifted the market, earnings reports, and the NEAR fund topic are not the accurate context tags for this specific ETH data either—I won’t force a connection.

If I were trading myself, I’m not participating right now. My direction is only set: a lightly-sized spot long position after predefined conditions are met. Only if the hourly chart closes above $2,710, then the subsequent pullback holds in the $2,695 to $2,710 range without breaking, and the total fund flow after Farside fills in its data doesn’t turn clearly negative, would I consider risking up to 2% of total capital to try it, without leverage. First target: trim half around $2,748; the remainder to watch near $2,790. A hard stop-loss at $2,670. If it drops back below $2,695 for two consecutive hours, I’ll close the position proactively rather than waiting for the hard stop-loss. If it breaks below $2,652 before entry, or if the complete fund data and the stage reading point in opposite directions, I’ll cancel the plan directly. Even if a breakout happens, I’ll treat it only as a verifiable trading condition—not as turning a temporary table into a guaranteed bullish catalyst. Discipline matters more than being first at the first green candle.

Why have these two models suddenly widened the gap? And what does it mean?

Put simply: money in the crypto stock market is starting to split apart. This split phenomenon shows the market is finding its own path to fragmentation.

Why is this news important?
At its core, it’s because the two biggest fundamental contradictions in crypto are now playing out in the stock space: efficiency (Solana) vs. compliance (Avalanche). Solana uses speed to attract users worldwide to buy and trade stocks, while Avalanche is building a compliance showcase under the SEC’s guidance. Now institutional capital doesn’t dare to just rush into Solana, but retail customers also don’t care for Avalanche’s complicated compliance processes—so both sides’ user numbers surge. That means Tokenized Stocks is no longer a single unified concept; it’s splitting into two completely different tracks.

Impact on the market
In the short term, it has limited impact on BTC and ETH prices, but in the long run it will change how capital is allocated in the crypto market. If Solana users continue to grow rapidly, there may be even more retail money flowing into the stock market via crypto channels in the future, indirectly supporting the broader market. As for Avalanche, institutional capital entering this space will draw increasing attention from traditional financial regulators, and stricter compliance requirements may follow.

这事根本原因在于加密世界两大基本矛盾在股票领域爆发了：效率（Solana） vs 合规（Avalanche）。Solana用速度吸引全球用户买卖股票，而Avalanche在SEC的指导下做合规样板。现在机构资金不敢随便跑Solana，但零售客户也看不上Avalanche的复杂合规流程，结果就是两边用户量都暴涨。意味着Tokenized Stocks不再是一个整体概念，而是分裂成两条完全不同的赛道。
